            "text": "Lis docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md (§7.4 : EF-32, EF-33, EF-35 ; RG-03 ; ENF-03,\r\nENF-04, EF-72), docs/architecture.md, backend/API.md,\r\nbackend/src/db/migrations/001_initial.sql (table applications) et docs/seed.md\r\n(candidatures de démo).\r\n\r\nObjectif : implémenter EF-32 et EF-33 de bout en bout (SQLite → API → React).\r\nHors périmètre : EF-30, EF-31, EF-34 (sélection d'un candidat), création du stage,\r\ntoute notification (EF-35).\r\nLe bouton « Candidater » peut aller dans la liste des offres existante. Utilise les\r\nconnexions de démo existantes.\r\n\r\nPropose un plan en 3 étapes séparées, chacune testable et commitée seule :\r\n1. candidater (avec message facultatif) ;\r\n2. consulter mes candidatures et leur statut ;\r\n3. retirer une candidature non traitée.\r\n\r\nPour chaque étape : fichiers créés/modifiés et leur rôle, routes d'API, règles\r\nvérifiées côté serveur, tests backend et frontend prévus, vérifications manuelles.\r\n\r\nDécisions déjà prises (à respecter) :\r\n- Seul un étudiant peut candidater (règle nommée dans permissions.ts) ; autre rôle → 403.\r\n- Uniquement sur une offre au statut PUBLISHED (RG-03), sinon refus ; offre inexistante → 404.\r\n- Pas de doublon : refus (409) si l'étudiant a déjà une candidature non retirée sur\r\n  cette offre. Contrôle dans le service + index unique partiel dans une nouvelle\r\n  migration 002 (ne pas modifier 001).\r\n- Après un retrait, l'étudiant peut candidater à nouveau : une nouvelle candidature\r\n  est créée, l'ancienne reste « Retirée » (historique conservé).\r\n- Message facultatif : vide ou espaces → null ; longueur maximale 1000 caractères.\r\n- Retrait = passage du statut à WITHDRAWN (pas de suppression), seulement depuis\r\n  IN_PROGRESS. SELECTED, REJECTED ou WITHDRAWN → refus (409).\r\n- Un étudiant ne voit et ne retire que ses propres candidatures, identifiées par la\r\n  session (req.user), jamais par un identifiant envoyé par le client.\r\n- Aucune donnée personnelle dans les URL (ENF-04) : pas de /students/:id/... ;\r\n  utiliser par exemple /applications/me.\r\n- Pas de blocage si l'étudiant a déjà un stage validé (non prévu par le CdC).\r\n- EF-72 (filtre par année en cours) : [à filtrer maintenant / noté comme limite].\r\n\r\nRespecte .github/copilot-instructions.md (couches controllers → services →\r\nrepositories, permissions.ts, HttpError, type guards, libellés français dans\r\nutils/labels.ts). Réutilise l'existant. Prévois des tests pour les refus, pas\r\nseulement pour les cas qui fonctionnent.\r\nSignale toute autre décision métier que le cahier des charges ne tranche pas.\r\nN'écris pas de code maintenant.",
            "kind": "text"
          }

            "prompt": "Read-only discovery for a planning task. In this workspace, inspect the exact requested references: docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md sections §7.4 (EF-32, EF-33, EF-35), RG-03, ENF-03, ENF-04, EF-72; docs/architecture.md; backend/API.md; backend/src/db/migrations/001_initial.sql applications table; docs/seed.md; plus the smallest relevant neighboring source/test files to identify existing conventions for auth req.user, permissions.ts, offers API/services/repos, migration ordering, frontend services/hooks/pages/labels.ts and tests.             "result": "No files changed. Findings below use the current code as convention evidence, not as a claim that the application workflow already exists.\n\n**Existing contract and behavior**\n- The cited requirements define the core: [RG-03](docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md#L139) limits applications to published offers; EF-32 allows an optional message and withdrawal before processing; EF-33 requires the student’s application statuses; EF-35 says no application notifications. [ENF-03 and ENF-04](docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md#L395) require server-side role checks and access limited to the people concerned, with no personal data in URLs.\n- [The `applications` table](backend/src/db/migrations/001_initial.sql#L124) already stores `message`, `applied_at`, and `IN_PROGRESS`, `SELECTED`, `REJECTED`, `WITHDRAWN`. It has ordinary indexes by offer and student, but no uniqueness constraint for duplicate applications. Existing seed data includes all four statuses, including a withdrawn application, in [`offersData.ts`](backend/src/db/seed/offersData.ts#L157).\n- The documented API has no application routes yet. Routes are mounted behind authentication in [`createApp`](backend/src/app.ts); `getCurrentUser(req)` reads the account reloaded by auth middleware from `req.user` ([`authenticate.ts`](backend/src/middlewares/authenticate.ts)). Keep ownership derived from that user, not a student ID supplied by the client.\n- Authorization conventions are named rules in [`permissions.ts`](backend/src/services/permissions.ts), applied with `authorize(...)` in controllers. Offer listing is a useful layered example: [`offers.controller.ts`](backend/src/controllers/offers.controller.ts), [`offers.service.ts`](backend/src/services/offers.service.ts), [`offers.repository.ts`](backend/src/repositories/offers.repository.ts), with API coverage in [`offers.test.ts`](backend/tests/offers.test.ts).\n- Migration files are sorted and applied once by [`runMigrations`](backend/src/db/migrate.ts). Migration tests currently expect only `001_initial.sql` in [`migrations.test.ts`](backend/tests/db/migrations.test.ts); schema constraints are tested separately in [`constraints.test.ts`](backend/tests/db/constraints.test.ts).\n- Frontend conventions are service → hook → page: [`offers.service.ts`](frontend/src/services/offers.service.ts), [`useOffers.ts`](frontend/src/hooks/useOffers.ts), [`OffersPage.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/OffersPage.tsx). Types and JSON guards live in `models/` and `utils/guards.ts`; French status labels live in [`labels.ts`](frontend/src/utils/labels.ts). There is no application model, service, hook, page, or status-label mapping yet. [`OffersPage.test.tsx`](frontend/tests/OffersPage.test.tsx) shows the current fetch-mock and UI-test pattern.\n- The API’s current `GET /offers` filters by visibility and optional period, but not academic year ([`offers.repository.ts`](backend/src/repositories/offers.repository.ts)). EF-72 requires lists of offers and applications to default to the current academic year ([requirement](docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md#L248)). Seed documentation identifies the current year and existing withdrawn fixture in [`seed.md`](docs/seed.md).\n\n**Three committable increments**\n1. **Submit an application:** add a student-only create endpoint, with published-offer validation, missing offer `404`, duplicate `409`, and blank-to-null/max-1000 message handling. Enforce ownership from `req.user`; add service/API tests and migration `002` for the partial unique index. Add constraint coverage for duplicate active rows and withdrawn history.\n2. **View own applications:** add `GET /applications/me`, with repository filtering by the authenticated student and no caller-provided identity. Add DTO/model/guard, service/hook/page, French status labels, and tests for status rendering and cross-student isolation.\n3. **Withdraw:** add a student-only action that changes an eligible application to `WITHDRAWN` rather than deleting it. Test that only `IN_PROGRESS` can be withdrawn and that the preserved history permits a later application under the chosen index rule.\n\n**Decisions still to resolve**\n- **EF-72:** decide whether current-year filtering is part of this work (including the existing offer catalog and `/applications/me`) or whether it will be explicitly recorded as a limitation. The cited requirement says “by default,” but does not define whether users can switch to prior years.\n- **“Active duplicate” predicate:** the user has specified a partial unique index and reapplication after withdrawal, but not whether only `IN_PROGRESS` blocks reapplication or whether `SELECTED`/`REJECTED` should also block it. That determines the index predicate and service behavior.\n- **Endpoint and response contract:** `/applications/me` is specified; submission and withdrawal HTTP methods/paths, response DTO fields, and ordering are not. A conventional candidate is `POST /applications` and a withdrawal action on an application resource, but the contract should be chosen before implementation.\n- **Transition failure contract:** EF-32 says withdrawal is allowed only before treatment, but does not define the response for withdrawing a non-`IN_PROGRESS` application, or withdrawing twice. Define whether these are `409` conflicts and use that consistently.\n- **Message normalization detail:** blank-to-null and maximum length are decided; whether to trim nonblank messages before storing and measuring that limit is not specified.",

Retourner les informations utiles sur l’offre et la candidature, et trier par date décroissante puis identifiant décroissant.\n- **Règles serveur :** étudiant seulement (`403`); le repository filtre exclusivement avec l’identité de session; l’historique inclut tous les statuts et reste limité au propriétaire.\n- **Tests :** backend, isolation entre deux étudiants, accès refusé aux autres rôles, liste vide et ordre d’affichage. Frontend : libellés de tous les statuts, états chargement/erreur/vide et accès à la page selon le rôle, dans un nouveau `frontend/tests/ApplicationsPage.test.tsx` et les tests de navigation concernés.\n- **Vérification manuelle :** comparer « Mes candidatures » avec deux comptes étudiants de démo et vérifier qu’aucune candidature de l’un n’apparaît chez l’autre. Commit suggéré : `feat: expose student application list`.\n\n**3. Retirer une candidature non traitée**\n\n- **Fichiers :** compléter le contrôleur, service et repository applications; ajouter le bouton dans `ApplicationsPage.tsx` et l’action correspondante au service frontend.\n- **Route :** `PATCH /applications/:applicationId/withdraw`, sans corps. L’URL contient uniquement l’identifiant de candidature, jamais une identité personnelle.\n- **Règles serveur :** étudiant propriétaire seulement; retrait atomique autorisé uniquement depuis `IN_PROGRESS`, avec passage à `WITHDRAWN` et conservation de la ligne. Ressource absente ou appartenant à un autre étudiant : `404`; candidature propre en `SELECTED`, `REJECTED` ou `WITHDRAWN` : `409`; autre rôle : `403`.\n- **Tests :** backend, retrait et conservation de l’historique, refus pour chaque statut non retirable, accès inter-étudiants et nouvelle candidature après retrait. Frontend : bouton visible uniquement pour `IN_PROGRESS`, statut actualisé après retrait et erreurs affichées.\n- **Vérification manuelle :** retirer une candidature en cours, recharger et vérifier qu’elle apparaît toujours comme « Retirée », puis recandidater à la même offre et constater deux entrées distinctes. Commit suggéré : `feat: allow students to withdraw applications`.\n\n**Décisions et limites**\n\nLe doublon est bloqué pour tout statut sauf `WITHDRAWN`; les statuts sélectionné et non retenu ne libèrent donc pas l’offre. Les erreurs retenues sont `409` pour une offre non publiée ou une transition impossible, et `404` pour une candidature absente ou appartenant à quelqu’un d’autre.                   "value": "No files changed. Findings below use the current code as convention evidence, not as a claim that the application workflow already exists.\n\n**Existing contract and behavior**\n- The cited requirements define the core: [RG-03](docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md#L139) limits applications to published offers; EF-32 allows an optional message and withdrawal before processing; EF-33 requires the student’s application statuses; EF-35 says no application notifications. [ENF-03 and ENF-04](docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md#L395) require server-side role checks and access limited to the people concerned, with no personal data in URLs.\n- [The `applications` table](backend/src/db/migrations/001_initial.sql#L124) already stores `message`, `applied_at`, and `IN_PROGRESS`, `SELECTED`, `REJECTED`, `WITHDRAWN`. It has ordinary indexes by offer and student, but no uniqueness constraint for duplicate applications. Existing seed data includes all four statuses, including a withdrawn application, in [`offersData.ts`](backend/src/db/seed/offersData.ts#L157).\n- The documented API has no application routes yet. Routes are mounted behind authentication in [`createApp`](backend/src/app.ts); `getCurrentUser(req)` reads the account reloaded by auth middleware from `req.user` ([`authenticate.ts`](backend/src/middlewares/authenticate.ts)). Keep ownership derived from that user, not a student ID supplied by the client.\n- Authorization conventions are named rules in [`permissions.ts`](backend/src/services/permissions.ts), applied with `authorize(...)` in controllers. Offer listing is a useful layered example: [`offers.controller.ts`](backend/src/controllers/offers.controller.ts), [`offers.service.ts`](backend/src/services/offers.service.ts), [`offers.repository.ts`](backend/src/repositories/offers.repository.ts), with API coverage in [`offers.test.ts`](backend/tests/offers.test.ts).\n- Migration files are sorted and applied once by [`runMigrations`](backend/src/db/migrate.ts). Migration tests currently expect only `001_initial.sql` in [`migrations.test.ts`](backend/tests/db/migrations.test.ts); schema constraints are tested separately in [`constraints.test.ts`](backend/tests/db/constraints.test.ts).\n- Frontend conventions are service → hook → page: [`offers.service.ts`](frontend/src/services/offers.service.ts), [`useOffers.ts`](frontend/src/hooks/useOffers.ts), [`OffersPage.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/OffersPage.tsx). Types and JSON guards live in `models/` and `utils/guards.ts`; French status labels live in [`labels.ts`](frontend/src/utils/labels.ts). There is no application model, service, hook, page, or status-label mapping yet. [`OffersPage.test.tsx`](frontend/tests/OffersPage.test.tsx) shows the current fetch-mock and UI-test pattern.\n- The API’s current `GET /offers` filters by visibility and optional period, but not academic year ([`offers.repository.ts`](backend/src/repositories/offers.repository.ts)). EF-72 requires lists of offers and applications to default to the current academic year ([requirement](docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md#L248)). Seed documentation identifies the current year and existing withdrawn fixture in [`seed.md`](docs/seed.md).\n\n**Three committable increments**\n1. **Submit an application:** add a student-only create endpoint, with published-offer validation, missing offer `404`, duplicate `409`, and blank-to-null/max-1000 message handling. Enforce ownership from `req.user`; add service/API tests and migration `002` for the partial unique index. Add constraint coverage for duplicate active rows and withdrawn history.\n2. **View own applications:** add `GET /applications/me`, with repository filtering by the authenticated student and no caller-provided identity. Add DTO/model/guard, service/hook/page, French status labels, and tests for status rendering and cross-student isolation.\n3. **Withdraw:** add a student-only action that changes an eligible application to `WITHDRAWN` rather than deleting it. Test that only `IN_PROGRESS` can be withdrawn and that the preserved history permits a later application under the chosen index rule.\n\n**Decisions still to resolve**\n- **EF-72:** decide whether current-year filtering is part of this work (including the existing offer catalog and `/applications/me`) or whether it will be explicitly recorded as a limitation. The cited requirement says “by default,” but does not define whether users can switch to prior years.\n- **“Active duplicate” predicate:** the user has specified a partial unique index and reapplication after withdrawal, but not whether only `IN_PROGRESS` blocks reapplication or whether `SELECTED`/`REJECTED` should also block it. That determines the index predicate and service behavior.\n- **Endpoint and response contract:** `/applications/me` is specified; submission and withdrawal HTTP methods/paths, response DTO fields, and ordering are not. A conventional candidate is `POST /applications` and a withdrawal action on an application resource, but the contract should be chosen before implementation.\n- **Transition failure contract:** EF-32 says withdrawal is allowed only before treatment, but does not define the response for withdrawing a non-`IN_PROGRESS` application, or withdrawing twice. Define whether these are `409` conflicts and use that consistently.\n- **Message normalization detail:** blank-to-null and maximum length are decided; whether to trim nonblank messages before storing and measuring that limit is not specified."
                }
              ]
            },

                                  "text": "| RG-04 | Quand l'administrateur sélectionne un candidat, l'offre passe au statut « Attribuée », le stage est créé et les autres candidatures à cette offre passent au statut « Non retenue ». | D-09, §3.15 |\n",

                                  "text": "| RG-05 | Un stage déclaré par l'étudiant ne compte qu'après validation par un administrateur. Aucune auto-validation n'est possible. | D-08 |\n",

                                  "text": "| RG-06 | Une offre liée à un stage ne peut pas être supprimée, seulement archivée. Une offre sans stage peut être supprimée. | D-12 |\n",

                                  "lineBreakBefore": true

                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 41
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 40,
                                  "text": "| RG-10 | Un étudiant peut avoir plusieurs stages, par exemple quand il recommence l'année suivante. Les stages passés sont conservés. | §6.5, §3.2 |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 40
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 39,
                                  "text": "| RG-11 | Le promoteur d'un stage doit être un contact de l'entreprise du stage, avec le rôle « Promoteur ». | §3.6 |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 39
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 38,
                                  "text": "| RG-12 | Une convention ne peut être générée que si l'entreprise a un nom, une adresse et au moins un contact « Signataire ». | D-15 |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 38
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 37,
                                  "text": "| RG-13 | Les entreprises et contacts créés par un étudiant gardent le statut « À vérifier » jusqu'à la validation du stage. | D-08, D-14 |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 37
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 36,
                                  "text": "| RG-14 | Il n'y a pas de mot de passe : tous les utilisateurs se connectent par un lien à usage unique envoyé par e-mail. | D-04, H-01 |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 36
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 35,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 35
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 34,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 34
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 33,
                                  "text": "## 7. Exigences fonctionnelles\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 33
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 32,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 32
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 31,
                                  "text": "### 7.1 Authentification\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 31
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 30,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 30
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 29,
                                  "text": "| Code | Exigence |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 29
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 28,
                                  "text": "|---|---|\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 28
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 27,
                                  "text": "| EF-01 | L'utilisateur saisit son adresse e-mail. Si elle correspond à un compte actif, l'application envoie un lien de connexion à usage unique, valable 30 minutes (H-02). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 27
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 26,
                                  "text": "| EF-02 | Le lien ouvre une session dont la durée est configurable. Un lien expiré ou déjà utilisé affiche un message clair et un bouton « Recevoir un nouveau lien ». L'administrateur n'a jamais à régénérer de lien à la main (O1). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 26
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 25,
                                  "text": "| EF-03 | Pour une adresse inconnue, l'application affiche le même message que pour une adresse connue, afin de ne pas révéler quelles adresses existent. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 25
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 24,
                                  "text": "| EF-04 | L'administrateur peut activer ou désactiver un compte (contact, étudiant ou administrateur). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 24
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 23,
                                  "text": "| EF-05 | Les anciens liens de gestion de Gesta (`Lien-partenaire`) ne donnent accès à rien dans la nouvelle application (§8.15). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 23
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 22,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 22
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 21,
                                  "text": "### 7.2 Entreprises et contacts\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 21
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 20,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 20
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 19,
                                  "text": "| Code | Exigence |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 19
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 18,
                                  "text": "|---|---|\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 18
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 17,
                                  "text": "| EF-10 | L'administrateur peut rechercher, créer, modifier et archiver une entreprise. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 17
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 16,
                                  "text": "| EF-11 | La fiche entreprise affiche son identité, ses coordonnées, ses contacts avec leurs rôles, ses offres et ses stages, filtrés par année académique. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 16
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 15,
                                  "text": "| EF-12 | L'administrateur peut créer un contact, le rattacher à une ou plusieurs entreprises et lui attribuer ou retirer des rôles. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 15
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 14,
                                  "text": "| EF-13 | Pendant la saisie d'une entreprise ou d'un contact, quel que soit l'utilisateur, l'application recherche les fiches proches et les propose. Pour une entreprise, elle compare le nom complet, le nom abrégé et la localité ; pour un contact, le nom, le prénom et l'e-mail. Elle tolère les différences de casse, d'accents et de petites fautes de frappe (D-14). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 14
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 13,
                                  "text": "| EF-14 | L'administrateur peut fusionner deux entreprises ou deux contacts. La fusion conserve toutes les associations : contacts, offres, stages et rattachements (§8.18). L'administrateur choisit, champ par champ, la valeur à garder. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 13
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 12,
                                  "text": "| EF-15 | L'administrateur voit la liste des fiches « À vérifier » et peut les confirmer ou les fusionner avec une fiche existante. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 12
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 11,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 11
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 10,
                                  "text": "### 7.3 Offres de stage\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 10
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 9,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 9
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 8,
                                  "text": "| Code | Exigence |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 8
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 7,
                                  "text": "|---|---|\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 7
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 6,
                                  "text": "| EF-20 | Un contact déposant crée une offre pour une de ses entreprises. Il indique le titre, la description du sujet, l'année académique, la période souhaitée et le contact promoteur prévu. Le promoteur est facultatif au dépôt. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 6
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 5,
                                  "text": "| EF-21 | Une offre déposée a le statut « Soumise ». Le déposant peut la modifier ou la retirer tant qu'elle n'est pas publiée. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 5
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 4,
                                  "text": "| EF-22 | L'administrateur voit la liste des offres soumises et en attente. Pour chacune, il peut **valider** (elle devient « Publiée »), **mettre en attente**, **modifier** la description ou les personnes associées, ou **supprimer** l'offre (dans le respect de RG-06) (§3.10). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 4
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 3,
                                  "text": "| EF-23 | L'administrateur peut aussi créer une offre lui-même, au nom d'une entreprise, par exemple à partir d'une proposition reçue par mail (§4.11). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 3
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 2,
                                  "text": "| EF-24 | L'administrateur peut archiver une offre publiée qui n'a pas trouvé d'étudiant. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 2
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 56,
                                  "text": "| EF-25 | Aucun historique des changements de statut n'est conservé, à part la date de dernière modification (§3.14). |",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 56
                              },
                              "references": []
                            }
                          ],
                          "props": {},
                          "references": []
                        }
                      ],
                      "props": {},
                      "references": []
                    }
                  }
                }
              ]
            },

                                  "priority": 35,

                                  "references": [],

                                }

                              },

                                {

                                  "text": "CREATE INDEX offers_status ON offers (status);\n",

                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 76,
                                  "text": "### 7.5 Stage déclaré par l'étudiant\n",

                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 72,
                                  "text": "| EF-40 | L'étudiant déclare un stage trouvé lui-même, sans offre préalable (§2.6, §3.18). Il recherche d'abord l'entreprise, puis le contact promoteur, parmi les fiches existantes (EF-13). S'il ne les trouve pas, il les crée : elles prennent le statut « À vérifier ». |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 72
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 71,
                                  "text": "| EF-41 | Il saisit ensuite le sujet, les dates de début et de fin, l'année académique et la période. Le stage a alors le statut « Déclaré ». |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 71
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 70,
                                  "text": "| EF-42 | L'administrateur voit la liste des stages déclarés. Il peut les valider (statut « Validé »), les corriger avant validation ou les refuser avec un motif visible par l'étudiant (D-08). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 70
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },

                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",

                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 69

                            },

                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 68,
                                  "text": "### 7.6 Dossier de stage\n",

                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 64,
                                  "text": "| EF-50 | Un stage contient : l'étudiant, l'entreprise, le sujet, l'offre d'origine s'il y en a une, le promoteur, le nom du superviseur interne, les dates de début et de fin, l'année académique, la période, le statut et la convention (§3.17, §3.22). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 64
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 63,
                                  "text": "| EF-51 | L'administrateur peut saisir ou modifier le nom du superviseur interne. Ce champ peut rester vide. L'application propose une liste « Stages sans superviseur » (D-10). Les superviseurs habituels de l'entreprise, repris de l'export, sont affichés à titre indicatif (§8.9). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 63
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 62,
                                  "text": "| EF-52 | L'administrateur peut corriger un stage validé : dates, promoteur, superviseur ou sujet. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 62
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 61,
                                  "text": "| EF-53 | La fiche étudiant affiche tous ses stages, triés par année et par période (RG-10). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 61
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 60,
                                  "text": "| EF-54 | Le promoteur voit la liste des stages qu'il suit, avec l'étudiant, les dates et le nom du superviseur. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 60
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 59,
                                  "text": "| EF-55 | L'administrateur peut annuler un stage, par exemple en cas d'abandon. Le stage reste dans l'historique avec le statut « Annulé ». |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 59
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 58,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 58
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 57,
                                  "text": "Cycle de vie d'un stage : `Déclaré → Validé → Terminé`, avec `Refusé` à partir de « Déclaré » et `Annulé` à partir de « Validé ». Un stage créé par la sélection d'un candidat (EF-34) commence directement au statut « Validé ». « Terminé » est attribué automatiquement après la date de fin.\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 57
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 56,
                                  "text": "\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 56
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },

                              "children": [

                                  "priority": 55,
                                  "text": "### 7.7 Convention\n",
                                  "references": [],

                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 51,
                                  "text": "| EF-60 | L'administrateur dépose et remplace le modèle de convention : un document avec des champs à remplacer (H-04). |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 51
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 50,
                                  "text": "| EF-61 | Depuis un stage validé, l'administrateur génère la convention. L'application injecte dans le modèle le nom de l'entreprise, son adresse et le nom du contact signataire (D-15). S'il y a plusieurs signataires, l'administrateur en choisit un. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 50
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 49,
                                  "text": "| EF-62 | Le document généré est téléchargeable et conservé dans le dossier du stage. La convention a alors le statut « Générée ». |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 49
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 48,
                                  "text": "| EF-63 | L'administrateur dépose le PDF signé ; la convention passe au statut « Signée » et la date de dépôt est enregistrée. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 48
                              },
                              "references": []
                            },
                            {
                              "type": 1,
                              "ctor": 2,
                              "ctorName": "R$e",
                              "children": [
                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 47,
                                  "text": "| EF-64 | L'administrateur peut régénérer une convention « Générée », par exemple après une correction de l'adresse. Une convention « Signée » ne peut pas être régénérée. |\n",
                                  "references": [],
                                  "lineBreakBefore": true
                                }
                              ],
                              "props": {
                                "priority": 47
                              },
                              "references": []

                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 46,

                                  "text": "| EF-71 | Les périodes sont configurables par année. Par défaut : P1 de septembre à décembre, P2 de février à mai, et « Autre » (§6.3).                                   "type": 2,

                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 25,

                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 24,
                                  "text": "| ENF-05 | Volumétrie supposée : quelques centaines d'étudiants par an, quelques centaines d'entreprises et quelques milliers de contacts (D-18). |\n",

            "path": "/c:/Users/rngi1/OneDrive - Haute Ecole Léonard de Vinci/VINCI/3 eme/IA/BINV3220y-groupe-9/backend/src/repositories/applications.repository.ts",
            "scheme": "file"
          },
          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "import type { Db } from \"../db/database.ts\";\nimport type { ApplicationDbo } from \"../models/application.ts\";\nimport type { OfferStatus } from \"../models/offer.ts\";\n\ninterface OfferStatusRow {\n  status: OfferStatus;\n}\n\ninterface ApplicationParams {\n  offerId: number;\n  studentId: number;\n  message: string | null;\n}\n\nexport const createApplicationsRepository = (db: Db) => {\n  const findOfferStatus = db.prepare<{ offerId: number }, OfferStatusRow>(\n    \"SELECT status FROM offers WHERE id = @offerId\",\n  );\n  const findActive = db.prepare<{ offerId: number; studentId: number }, { id: number }>(`\n    SELECT id FROM applications\n    WHERE offer_id = @offerId AND student_id = @studentId AND status <> 'WITHDRAWN'\n    LIMIT 1\n  `);\n  const insertApplication = db.prepare<ApplicationParams>(`\n    INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id, message)\n    VALUES (@offerId, @studentId, @message)\n  `);\n  const findById = db.prepare<{ id: number }, ApplicationDbo>(`\n    SELECT id, offer_id, student_id, message, status, applied_at\n    FROM applications WHERE id = @id\n  `);\n\n  return {\n    findOfferStatus: (offerId: number): OfferStatus | undefined =>\n      findOfferStatus.get({ offerId })?.status,\n    hasActiveForOffer: (offerId: number, studentId: number): boolean =>\n      findActive.get({ offerId, studentId }) !== undefined,\n    create: (params: ApplicationParams): ApplicationDbo => {\n      const result = insertApplication.run(params);\n      const application = findById.get({ id: Number(result.lastInsertRowid) });\n      if (application === undefined) throw new Error(\"Candidature créée introuvable\");\n      return application;\n    },\n  };\n};\n\nexport type ApplicationsRepository = ReturnType<typeof createApplicationsRepository>;",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 1,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }
            ],

          ],

                "text": "import { toApplication } from \"../mappers/application.mapper.ts\";\nimport type { Application } from \"../models/application.ts\";\nimport type { User } from \"../models/user.ts\";\nimport type { ApplicationsRepository } from \"../repositories/applications.repository.ts\";\nimport { HttpError } from \"../utils/httpError.ts\";\nimport { canApplyToOffers } from \"./permissions.ts\";\n\nconst MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 1000;\n\nconst isUniqueConstraintError = (error: unknown): boolean =>\n  typeof error === \"object\" &&\n  error !== null &&\n  \"code\" in error &&\n  error.code === \"SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE\";\n\nexport const createApplicationsService = (repository: ApplicationsRepository) => ({\n  applyToOffer: (student: User, offerId: number, message?: string): Application => {\n    if (!canApplyToOffers(student)) {\n      throw new HttpError(403, \"FORBIDDEN\", \"Seul un étudiant peut candidater\");\n    }\n\n    const offerStatus = repository.findOfferStatus(offerId);\n    if (offerStatus === undefined) {\n      throw new HttpError(404, \"NOT_FOUND\", \"Offre introuvable\");\n    }\n    if (offerStatus !== \"PUBLISHED\") {\n      throw new HttpError(409, \"OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED\", \"Cette offre n'est pas publiée\");\n    }\n\n    const normalizedMessage = message?.trim() || null;\n    if (normalizedMessage !== null && normalizedMessage.length > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH) {\n      throw new HttpError(\n        400,\n        \"INVALID_BODY\",\n        `Le message ne peut pas dépasser ${MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH} caractères`,\n      );\n    }\n\n    if (repository.hasActiveForOffer(offerId, student.id)) {\n      throw new HttpError(409, \"APPLICATION_EXISTS\", \"Vous avez déjà candidaté à cette offre\");\n    }\n\n    try {\n      return toApplication(\n        repository.create({ offerId, studentId: student.id, message: normalizedMessage }),\n      );\n    } catch (error) {\n      if (isUniqueConstraintError(error)) {\n        throw new HttpError(409, \"APPLICATION_EXISTS\", \"Vous avez déjà candidaté à cette offre\");\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n  },\n});\n\nexport type ApplicationsService = ReturnType<typeof createApplicationsService>;",

          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "import { Router } from \"express\";\nimport { toApplicationDto } from \"../mappers/application.mapper.ts\";\nimport { getCurrentUser } from \"../middlewares/authenticate.ts\";\nimport { authorize } from \"../middlewares/authorize.ts\";\nimport type { ApplicationsService } from \"../services/applications.service.ts\";\nimport { canApplyToOffers } from \"../services/permissions.ts\";\nimport { HttpError } from \"../utils/httpError.ts\";\n\ninterface CreateApplicationBody {\n  offerId: number;\n  message?: string;\n}\n\nconst isCreateApplicationBody = (value: unknown): value is CreateApplicationBody => {\n  if (typeof value !== \"object\" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;\n  const body = value as Record<string, unknown>;\n  return (\n    typeof body.offerId === \"number\" &&\n    Number.isInteger(body.offerId) &&\n    body.offerId > 0 &&\n    (body.message === undefined || typeof body.message === \"string\")\n  );\n};\n\nexport const createApplicationsRouter = (applicationsService: ApplicationsService) => {\n  const router = Router();\n\n  router.post(\"/\", authorize(canApplyToOffers), (req, res) => {\n    const body: unknown = req.body;\n    if (!isCreateApplicationBody(body)) {\n      throw new HttpError(\n        400,\n        \"INVALID_BODY\",\n        \"Le corps doit contenir offerId (entier positif) et un message facultatif\",\n      );\n    }\n\n    const application = applicationsService.applyToOffer(\n      getCurrentUser(req),\n      body.offerId,\n      body.message,\n    );\n    res.status(201).json(toApplicationDto(application));\n  });\n\n  return router;\n};",

          "edits": [

              {
                "text": "import type { ContactRole, User } from \"../models/user.ts\";\n\n// Règles d'accès du CdC (§ 4), indépendantes d'Express. Les contrôleurs les appliquent\n// avec le middleware authorize ; les services s'en servent pour filtrer les données.\n\nexport const isAdmin = (user: User): boolean => user.kind === \"ADMIN\";\n\nexport const isStudent = (user: User): boolean => user.kind === \"STUDENT\";\n\nexport const canApplyToOffers = (user: User): boolean => isStudent(user);\n\n/** Les rôles d'un contact s'exercent dans toutes ses entreprises. */\nexport const hasContactRole = (user: User, role: ContactRole): boolean =>\n  user.kind === \"CONTACT\" && user.roles.includes(role);\n\n/**\n * Consulter des offres : l'administrateur, l'étudiant et le déposant. Un contact\n * seulement promoteur ou signataire n'y a pas accès.\n */\nexport const canListOffers = (user: User): boolean =>\n  isAdmin(user) || isStudent(user) || hasContactRole(user, \"DEPOSITOR\");\n",

                "text": "import express from \"express\";\nimport type { AuthConfig } from \"./config.ts\";\nimport { createApplicationsRouter } from \"./controllers/applications.controller.ts\";\nimport { createAuthRouter } from \"./controllers/auth.controller.ts\";\nimport { createCompaniesRouter } from \"./controllers/companies.controller.ts\";\nimport { healthRouter } from \"./controllers/health.controller.ts\";\nimport { createOffersRouter } from \"./controllers/offers.controller.ts\";\nimport type { Db } from \"./db/database.ts\";\nimport { createAuthenticate } from \"./middlewares/authenticate.ts\";\nimport { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from \"./middlewares/errorHandler.ts\";\nimport { createCompaniesRepository } from \"./repositories/companies.repository.ts\";\nimport { createApplicationsRepository } from \"./repositories/applications.repository.ts\";\nimport { createOffersRepository } from \"./repositories/offers.repository.ts\";\nimport { createUsersRepository } from \"./repositories/users.repository.ts\";\nimport { createAuthService } from \"./services/auth.service.ts\";\nimport { createCompaniesService } from \"./services/companies.service.ts\";\nimport { createApplicationsService } from \"./services/applications.service.ts\";\nimport { createOffersService } from \"./services/offers.service.ts\";\n\nexport const createApp = (db: Db, authConfig: AuthConfig) => {\n  const authService = createAuthService(createUsersRepository(db), authConfig.jwtSecret);\n  const companiesService = createCompaniesService(createCompaniesRepository(db));\n  const applicationsService = createApplicationsService(createApplicationsRepository(db));\n  const offersService = createOffersService(createOffersRepository(db));\n  const authenticate = createAuthenticate(authService);\n\n  const app = express();\n\n  app.use(express.json());\n\n  // Routes publiques\n  app.use(\"/health\", healthRouter);\n  app.use(\"/auth\", createAuthRouter(authService, authenticate, authConfig.demoAuthEnabled));\n\n  // Routes protégées : l'utilisateur est identifié avant d'atteindre le contrôleur.\n  app.use(\"/companies\", authenticate, createCompaniesRouter(companiesService));\n  app.use(\"/offers\", authenticate, createOffersRouter(offersService));\n  app.use(\"/applications\", authenticate, createApplicationsRouter(applicationsService));\n\n  app.use(notFoundHandler);\n  app.use(errorHandler);\n\n  return app;\n};\n",
