                "text": "import { describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\nimport { IN_MEMORY, openDatabase } from \"../../src/db/database.ts\";\nimport { runMigrations } from \"../../src/db/migrate.ts\";\nimport { SEEDED_TABLES } from \"../../src/db/seed/seed.ts\";\n\nconst listTables = (db: ReturnType<typeof openDatabase>): string[] =>\n  (\n    db\n      .prepare(\"SELECT name FROM sqlite_schema WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name\")\n      .all() as { name: string }[]\n  ).map((row) => row.name);\n\ndescribe(\"runMigrations\", () => {\n  it(\"crée toutes les tables sur une base vierge\", () => {\n    const db = openDatabase(IN_MEMORY);\n\n    expect(runMigrations(db)).toEqual([\"001_initial.sql\", \"002_applications_active_unique.sql\"]);\n    expect(listTables(db)).toEqual([...SEEDED_TABLES, \"schema_migrations\"].sort());\n  });\n\n  it(\"n'applique pas deux fois la même migration\", () => {\n    const db = openDatabase(IN_MEMORY);\n    runMigrations(db);\n\n    expect(runMigrations(db)).toEqual([]);\n  });\n\n  it(\"active les clés étrangères\", () => {\n    const db = openDatabase(IN_MEMORY);\n\n    expect(db.pragma(\"foreign_keys\", { simple: true })).toBe(1);\n  });\n});\n",

                "text": "import request from \"supertest\";\nimport { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\nimport { ADMINISTRATOR, CONTACT, OFFER, STUDENT } from \"../src/db/seed/seedIds.ts\";\nimport type { Db } from \"../src/db/database.ts\";\nimport { createTestApp, tokenFor } from \"./helpers/testApp.ts\";\nimport { createTestDatabase } from \"./helpers/testDatabase.ts\";\n\nlet db: Db;\nlet app: ReturnType<typeof createTestApp>;\n\nbeforeEach(() => {\n  db = createTestDatabase();\n  app = createTestApp(db);\n});\n\nconst applyAs = (kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\", id: number, body: unknown) =>\n  request(app)\n    .post(\"/applications\")\n    .set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, id))\n    .send(body);\n\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : accès\", () => {\n  it(\"refuse une requête sans session (401)\", async () => {\n    const response = await request(app).post(\"/applications\").send({ offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(401);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [\"administrateur\", \"ADMIN\" as const, ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ],\n    [\"contact déposant\", \"CONTACT\" as const, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE],\n  ])(\"refuse une candidature par %s (403)\", async (_profile, kind, id) => {\n    const response = await applyAs(kind, id, { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : création\", () => {\n  it(\"crée une candidature avec un message normalisé\", async () => {\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\n      message: \"  Le sujet m'intéresse.  \",\n    });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\n    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\n      message: \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\",\n      status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\n    });\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"id\");\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"appliedAt\");\n    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty(\"studentId\");\n    const stored = db\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\n  });\n\n  it.each([undefined, \"\", \"   \"])(\"accepte un message vide (%s) et le stocke à NULL\", async (message) => {\n    const body = { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, ...(message === undefined ? {} : { message }) };\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, body);\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\n    expect(response.body.message).toBeNull();\n    const stored = db\n      .prepare(\"SELECT message FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\n      .get(response.body.id) as { message: string | null };\n    expect(stored.message).toBeNull();\n  });\n\n  it(\"accepte un message normalisé de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\n      message: ` ${\"x\".repeat(1000)} `,\n    });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\n    expect(response.body.message).toHaveLength(1000);\n  });\n\n  it(\"rejette un message normalisé de plus de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\n      message: \"x\".repeat(1001),\n    });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"dérive l'étudiant de la session et ignore tout studentId fourni\", async () => {\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\n      studentId: STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO,\n    });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\n    const stored = db\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : refus\", () => {\n  it(\"rejette un corps invalide\", async () => {\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\n      offerId: 0,\n      message: 12,\n    });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"renvoie 404 pour une offre inexistante\", async () => {\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, { offerId: 999 });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(404);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"NOT_FOUND\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse une offre existante qui n'est pas publiée (409)\", async () => {\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\n      offerId: OFFER.CLIENT_PORTAL,\n    });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(409);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED\");\n  });\n\n  it.each([\"IN_PROGRESS\", \"SELECTED\", \"REJECTED\"] as const)(\n    \"refuse une candidature déjà existante au statut %s\",\n    async (status) => {\n      if (status !== \"IN_PROGRESS\") {\n        db.prepare(\n          \"INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\n        ).run(OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, status);\n      }\n      const offerId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? OFFER.FLEET_APP : OFFER.DATA_QUALITY;\n      const studentId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT : STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO;\n\n      const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", studentId, { offerId });\n\n      expect(response.status).toBe(409);\n      expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"APPLICATION_EXISTS\");\n    },\n  );\n\n  it(\"permet de candidater à nouveau après une candidature retirée\", async () => {\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD, { offerId: OFFER.BILLING_API });\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\n    expect(response.body.status).toBe(\"IN_PROGRESS\");\n  });\n});",

                "text": "import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\nimport type { Db } from \"../../src/db/database.ts\";\nimport {\n  ACADEMIC_YEAR,\n  COMPANY,\n  CONTACT,\n  OFFER,\n  PERIOD,\n  STUDENT,\n} from \"../../src/db/seed/seedIds.ts\";\nimport { createTestDatabase } from \"../helpers/testDatabase.ts\";\n\n// Les cas invalides sont construits ici, jamais dans le seed.\n\nlet db: Db;\n\nbeforeEach(() => {\n  db = createTestDatabase();\n});\n\nconst validOffer = {\n  company_id: COMPANY.ORBIS,\n  depositor_contact_id: CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE,\n  promoter_contact_id: CONTACT.NADIA_CHERIF,\n  academic_year_id: ACADEMIC_YEAR.Y2026_2027,\n  period_id: PERIOD.Y2026_2027_P1,\n  title: \"Offre de test\",\n  description: \"Description\",\n  status: \"SUBMITTED\",\n};\n\nconst insertOffer = (overrides: Partial<Record<keyof typeof validOffer, unknown>> = {}) =>\n  db\n    .prepare(\n      `INSERT INTO offers (company_id, depositor_contact_id, promoter_contact_id,\n         academic_year_id, period_id, title, description, status)\n       VALUES (@company_id, @depositor_contact_id, @promoter_contact_id,\n         @academic_year_id, @period_id, @title, @description, @status)`,\n    )\n    .run({ ...validOffer, ...overrides });\n\ndescribe(\"offres\", () => {\n  it(\"accepte une offre valide\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer()).not.toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse une entreprise inexistante\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer({ company_id: 999 })).toThrow(/FOREIGN KEY/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un déposant non rattaché à l'entreprise\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer({ depositor_contact_id: CONTACT.CLAIRE_DUMONT })).toThrow(\n      /FOREIGN KEY/,\n    );\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un promoteur non rattaché à l'entreprise\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer({ promoter_contact_id: CONTACT.FATOU_NDIAYE })).toThrow(\n      /FOREIGN KEY/,\n    );\n  });\n\n  it(\"accepte une offre sans promoteur\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer({ promoter_contact_id: null })).not.toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it(\"accepte une offre sans déposant, créée par un administrateur\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer({ depositor_contact_id: null })).not.toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse une période d'une autre année académique\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer({ period_id: PERIOD.Y2025_2026_P1 })).toThrow(/FOREIGN KEY/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un statut inconnu\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer({ status: \"Publiée\" })).toThrow(/CHECK/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un titre vide\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertOffer({ title: \"   \" })).toThrow(/CHECK/);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"contacts et rattachements\", () => {\n  it(\"refuse un e-mail déjà utilisé, quelle que soit la casse\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\"INSERT INTO contacts (first_name, last_name, email) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\")\n        .run(\"Autre\", \"Personne\", \"CLAIRE.DUMONT@lumen-digital.test\"),\n    ).toThrow(/UNIQUE/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un rattachement en double\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\"INSERT INTO company_contacts (company_id, contact_id) VALUES (?, ?)\")\n        .run(COMPANY.ORBIS, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE),\n    ).toThrow(/UNIQUE|PRIMARY KEY/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un rôle pour un contact inexistant\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db.prepare(\"INSERT INTO contact_roles (contact_id, role) VALUES (?, ?)\").run(999, \"PROMOTER\"),\n    ).toThrow(/FOREIGN KEY/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un rôle en double\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\"INSERT INTO contact_roles (contact_id, role) VALUES (?, ?)\")\n        .run(CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE, \"DEPOSITOR\"),\n    ).toThrow(/UNIQUE|PRIMARY KEY/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un rôle inconnu\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\"INSERT INTO contact_roles (contact_id, role) VALUES (?, ?)\")\n        .run(CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE, \"ADMIN\"),\n    ).toThrow(/CHECK/);\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"statuts\", () => {\n  it(\"accepte une entreprise et un contact « À vérifier »\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\"INSERT INTO companies (name, short_name, locality, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\")\n        .run(\"Nouvelle SRL\", \"Nouvelle\", \"Namur\", \"TO_VERIFY\"),\n    ).not.toThrow();\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\"INSERT INTO contacts (first_name, last_name, email, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)\")\n        .run(\"Nouveau\", \"Contact\", \"nouveau.contact@nouvelle.test\", \"TO_VERIFY\"),\n    ).not.toThrow();\n  });\n});\n\ndescribe(\"années académiques\", () => {\n  it(\"refuse une deuxième année courante\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\n          \"INSERT INTO academic_years (label, start_date, end_date, is_current) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 1)\",\n        )\n        .run(\"2027-2028\", \"2027-09-13\", \"2028-09-10\"),\n    ).toThrow(/UNIQUE/);\n  });\n});\n\nconst insertInternship = (overrides: Record<string, unknown> = {}) =>\n  db\n    .prepare(\n      `INSERT INTO internships (student_id, company_id, subject, promoter_contact_id,\n         start_date, end_date, academic_year_id, period_id)\n       VALUES (@student_id, @company_id, @subject, @promoter_contact_id,\n         @start_date, @end_date, @academic_year_id, @period_id)`,\n    )\n    .run({\n      student_id: STUDENT.LEA_MERTENS,\n      company_id: COMPANY.DATAVIA,\n      subject: \"Sujet de test\",\n      promoter_contact_id: CONTACT.FATOU_NDIAYE,\n      start_date: \"2027-02-08\",\n      end_date: \"2027-05-28\",\n      academic_year_id: ACADEMIC_YEAR.Y2026_2027,\n      period_id: PERIOD.Y2026_2027_P2,\n      ...overrides,\n    });\n\ndescribe(\"candidatures et stages\", () => {\n  it(\"refuse une deuxième candidature non retirée pour la même offre et le même étudiant\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\"INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id) VALUES (?, ?)\")\n        .run(OFFER.FLEET_APP, STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT),\n    ).toThrow(/UNIQUE/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"autorise une nouvelle candidature après retrait\", () => {\n    expect(() =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\"INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id) VALUES (?, ?)\")\n        .run(OFFER.BILLING_API, STUDENT.INES_HADDAD),\n    ).not.toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it(\"accepte un stage valide, avec ou sans promoteur\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertInternship()).not.toThrow();\n    expect(() => insertInternship({ promoter_contact_id: null })).not.toThrow();\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un promoteur de stage non rattaché à l'entreprise\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertInternship({ promoter_contact_id: CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE })).toThrow(\n      /FOREIGN KEY/,\n    );\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un stage sans sujet\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertInternship({ subject: \" \" })).toThrow(/CHECK/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un deuxième stage pour la même offre\", () => {\n    const insertWithOffer = () =>\n      db\n        .prepare(\n          `INSERT INTO internships (student_id, company_id, offer_id, subject,\n             start_date, end_date, academic_year_id, period_id)\n           VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)`,\n        )\n        .run(\n          STUDENT.LEA_MERTENS,\n          COMPANY.DATAVIA,\n          OFFER.CLOUD_MIGRATION,\n          \"Sujet de test\",\n          \"2027-02-08\",\n          \"2027-05-28\",\n          ACADEMIC_YEAR.Y2026_2027,\n          PERIOD.Y2026_2027_P2,\n        );\n\n    expect(insertWithOffer).toThrow(/UNIQUE/);\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse un stage dont la date de fin précède le début\", () => {\n    expect(() => insertInternship({ start_date: \"2027-05-28\", end_date: \"2027-02-08\" })).toThrow(\n      /CHECK/,\n    );\n  });\n});\n",

        {

          "uri": {
            "$mid": 1,
            "fsPath": "c:\\Users\\rngi1\\OneDrive - Haute Ecole Léonard de Vinci\\VINCI\\3 eme\\IA\\BINV3220y-groupe-9\\backend\\API.md",
            "_sep": 1,
            "external": "file:///c%3A/Users/rngi1/OneDrive%20-%20Haute%20Ecole%20L%C3%A9onard%20de%20Vinci/VINCI/3%20eme/IA/BINV3220y-groupe-9/backend/API.md",

          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "# API Gesta\r\n\r\nToutes les réponses sont en JSON. En développement, le frontend appelle `/api/...` et le\r\nproxy Vite transmet la requête au backend sans le préfixe `/api`.\r\n\r\nLes requêtes d'exemple se trouvent dans `http/` (extension REST Client de VS Code).\r\n\r\n## Authentification\r\n\r\nLes routes protégées exigent l'en-tête `Authorization` contenant le jeton obtenu à la\r\nconnexion (sans préfixe). Le jeton ne contient que l'identité (`kind`, `id`) ; à chaque\r\nrequête, le backend relit en base le compte, ses rôles et ses entreprises. Un compte\r\ndésactivé, ou un contact sans rôle, ne peut plus accéder à l'API.\r\n\r\n> **Mode démo.** La connexion réelle par lien envoyé par e-mail (CdC EF-01) n'est pas\r\n> implémentée. En développement local, `DEMO_AUTH_ENABLED=true` permet de se connecter\r\n> **sans mot de passe** sous un utilisateur fictif. Ce n'est pas une authentification :\r\n> le serveur refuse de démarrer avec ce mode si `NODE_ENV=production`.\r\n\r\n## Format des erreurs\r\n\r\nToute erreur a la même forme :\r\n\r\n```json\r\n{ \"error\": { \"code\": \"INVALID_QUERY\", \"message\": \"Le paramètre q doit apparaître une seule fois\" } }\r\n```\r\n\r\n| Statut | Code | Cas |\r\n|---|---|---|\r\n| 400 | `INVALID_QUERY` | Paramètre de requête invalide |\r\n| 400 | `INVALID_BODY` | Corps de requête invalide |\r\n| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED` | Session absente, expirée ou invalide ; compte non autorisé à se connecter |\r\n| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Utilisateur connecté, mais sans droit sur la ressource |\r\n| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | Route inconnue |\r\n| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Erreur inattendue du serveur |\r\n\r\n## GET /health\r\n\r\nIndique que l'API répond.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : `{ \"status\": \"ok\" }`\r\n\r\n## GET /auth/demo-users\r\n\r\n*Mode démo uniquement.* Liste les utilisateurs qui peuvent se connecter : comptes actifs,\r\net contacts ayant au moins un rôle.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'utilisateurs (même format que `GET /auth/me`)\r\n- `404` : mode démo désactivé\r\n\r\n## POST /auth/demo-login\r\n\r\n*Mode démo uniquement.* Ouvre une session sous l'identité choisie, sans mot de passe.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Body JSON : `{ \"kind\": \"ADMIN\" | \"STUDENT\" | \"CONTACT\", \"id\": 4 }`\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : `{ \"token\": \"…\", \"user\": { … } }`\r\n- `400` `INVALID_BODY` : `kind` inconnu ou `id` qui n'est pas un entier positif\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : utilisateur inexistant, inactif, à vérifier, ou contact sans rôle\r\n- `404` : mode démo désactivé\r\n\r\n## GET /auth/me\r\n\r\nRetourne l'utilisateur connecté.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` :\r\n\r\n```json\r\n{\r\n  \"kind\": \"CONTACT\",\r\n  \"id\": 4,\r\n  \"firstName\": \"Julien\",\r\n  \"lastName\": \"Lambert\",\r\n  \"email\": \"julien.lambert@lumen.test\",\r\n  \"roles\": [\"DEPOSITOR\", \"PROMOTER\", \"SIGNATORY\"],\r\n  \"companies\": [\r\n    { \"id\": 3, \"shortName\": \"Lumen Data\" },\r\n    { \"id\": 2, \"shortName\": \"Lumen Digital\" }\r\n  ]\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n`roles` et `companies` sont vides pour un administrateur ou un étudiant.\r\n\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : jeton absent, invalide ou expiré, ou compte désactivé\r\n\r\n## GET /companies\r\n\r\nListe les entreprises, triées par nom complet. Un administrateur voit toutes les\r\nentreprises ; les autres utilisateurs ne voient que les entreprises actives.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Paramètre facultatif `q` : texte cherché dans le nom complet et le nom abrégé, sans tenir\r\n  compte de la casse. Une valeur vide est ignorée. 100 caractères au maximum.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'entreprises\r\n\r\n```json\r\n[\r\n  {\r\n    \"id\": 2,\r\n    \"name\": \"Lumen Digital SRL\",\r\n    \"shortName\": \"Lumen Digital\",\r\n    \"locality\": \"Louvain-la-Neuve\",\r\n    \"status\": \"ACTIVE\"\r\n  }\r\n]\r\n```\r\n\r\n`status` vaut `ACTIVE`, `TO_VERIFY` (fiche à vérifier) ou `ARCHIVED`.\r\n\r\n- `400` `INVALID_QUERY` : `q` est répété ou dépasse 100 caractères.\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide.\r\n\r\n## GET /offers\r\n\r\nListe les offres visibles par l'utilisateur connecté, de l'année académique la plus\r\nrécente à la plus ancienne, puis de la plus récente à la plus ancienne.\r\n\r\n| Profil | Offres retournées |\r\n|---|---|\r\n| Administrateur | Toutes |\r\n| Étudiant | Les offres publiées |\r\n| Contact déposant | Les offres qu'il a déposées, quel que soit leur statut |\r\n| Contact sans rôle de déposant | Aucun accès (403) |\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Paramètre facultatif `period` : `P1`, `P2` ou `Autre`. En son absence, toutes les\r\n  périodes visibles pour le profil sont retournées.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'offres\r\n\r\n```json\r\n[\r\n  {\r\n    \"id\": 3,\r\n    \"title\": \"API REST de facturation\",\r\n    \"companyShortName\": \"Orbis\",\r\n    \"academicYear\": \"2026-2027\",\r\n    \"period\": \"P2\",\r\n    \"status\": \"PUBLISHED\"\r\n  }\r\n]\r\n```\r\n\r\n`period` vaut `P1`, `P2` ou `OTHER`. `status` vaut `SUBMITTED` (soumise), `PENDING`\r\n(en attente), `PUBLISHED` (publiée), `ASSIGNED` (attribuée) ou `ARCHIVED` (archivée).\r\n\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide.\r\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : contact seulement promoteur ou signataire.\r\n- `400` `INVALID_QUERY` : paramètre `period` répété ou différent de `P1`, `P2` et `Autre`.\r\n\n## POST /applications\n\nUn étudiant candidate à une offre publiée. L'étudiant est déterminé par la session, jamais\npar une valeur du corps de la requête. Le message est facultatif; les espaces extérieurs\nsont supprimés, une valeur vide devient `null`, et le texte normalisé ne peut pas dépasser\n1000 caractères.\n\n### Requête\n\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\n- Body JSON : `{ \"offerId\": 5, \"message\": \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\" }`\n- `message` peut être omis ou être une chaîne vide.\n\n### Réponses\n\n- `201` : candidature créée\n\n```json\n{\n  \"id\": 7,\n  \"offerId\": 5,\n  \"message\": \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\",\n  \"status\": \"IN_PROGRESS\",\n  \"appliedAt\": \"2026-11-09 12:00:00\"\n}\n```\n\n- `400` `INVALID_BODY` : corps invalide ou message de plus de 1000 caractères\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : utilisateur connecté qui n'est pas étudiant\n- `404` `NOT_FOUND` : offre inexistante\n- `409` `OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED` : offre existante dont le statut n'est pas `PUBLISHED`\n- `409` `APPLICATION_EXISTS` : candidature déjà présente pour cet étudiant et cette offre\n  avec un statut différent de `WITHDRAWN`\n",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 210,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }
            ],

                "text": "### Connexion de démo : étudiant Lucas\n# @name student\nPOST http://localhost:3000/auth/demo-login\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"kind\": \"STUDENT\", \"id\": 1 }\n\n### Connexion de démo : étudiant Dmytro (utilisé pour candidater sans message)\n# @name studentWithoutMessage\nPOST http://localhost:3000/auth/demo-login\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"kind\": \"STUDENT\", \"id\": 8 }\n\n### Connexion de démo : administratrice\n# @name admin\nPOST http://localhost:3000/auth/demo-login\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"kind\": \"ADMIN\", \"id\": 1 }\n\n### Connexion de démo : contact déposant Marc\n# @name depositor\nPOST http://localhost:3000/auth/demo-login\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"kind\": \"CONTACT\", \"id\": 2 }\n\n### Candidater avec un message (offre publiée 5)\nPOST http://localhost:3000/applications\nAuthorization: {{student.response.body.token}}\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"offerId\": 5, \"message\": \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\" }\n\n### Candidater sans message (offre publiée 5)\nPOST http://localhost:3000/applications\nAuthorization: {{studentWithoutMessage.response.body.token}}\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"offerId\": 5 }\n\n### Erreur 409 : doublon (à lancer après la candidature de Lucas ci-dessus)\nPOST http://localhost:3000/applications\nAuthorization: {{student.response.body.token}}\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"offerId\": 5, \"message\": \"Nouvelle tentative\" }\n\n### Erreur 409 : offre existante non publiée (offre soumise 2)\nPOST http://localhost:3000/applications\nAuthorization: {{student.response.body.token}}\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"offerId\": 2 }\n\n### Erreur 403 candidature par un contact déposant\nPOST http://localhost:3000/applications\nAuthorization: {{depositor.response.body.token}}\nContent-Type: application/json\n\n{ \"offerId\": 5 }",

              {
                "text": "export const APPLICATION_STATUSES = [\n  \"IN_PROGRESS\",\n  \"SELECTED\",\n  \"REJECTED\",\n  \"WITHDRAWN\",\n] as const;\n\nexport type ApplicationStatus = (typeof APPLICATION_STATUSES)[number];\n\nexport interface Application {\n  id: number;\n  offerId: number;\n  message: string | null;\n  status: ApplicationStatus;\n  appliedAt: string;\n}",

=>\r\n  isOneOf(COMPANY_STATUSES, value);\r\n\r\nexport const isCompany = (value: unknown): value is Company =>\r\n  isRecord(value) &&\r\n  typeof value.id === \"number\" &&\r\n  typeof value.name === \"string\" &&\r\n  typeof value.shortName === \"string\" &&\r\n  typeof value.locality === \"string\" &&\r\n  isCompanyStatus(value.status);\r\n\r\nexport const isCompanyList = (value: unknown): value is Company[] =>\r\n  Array.isArray(value) && value.every(isCompany);\r\n\r\nconst isCompanySummary = (value: unknown): value is CompanySummary =>\r\n  isRecord(value) && typeof value.id === \"number\" && typeof value.shortName === \"string\";\r\n\r\nexport const isUser = (value: unknown): value is User =>\r\n  isRecord(value) &&\r\n  isOneOf(USER_KINDS, value.kind) &&\r\n  typeof value.id === \"number\" &&\r\n  typeof value.firstName === \"string\" &&\r\n  typeof value.lastName === \"string\" &&\r\n  typeof value.email === \"string\" &&\r\n  Array.isArray(value.roles) &&\r\n isRecord(value) &&\n  typeof value.id === \"number\" &&\n  typeof value.offerId === \"number\" &&\n  (value.message === null || typeof value.message === \"string\") &&\n  isOneOf(APPLICATION_STATUSES,                 "text": "import type { Offer } from \"../models/offer.ts\";\nimport { OFFER_STATUS_LABELS, OFFER_STATUS_TONES, PERIOD_LABELS } from \"../utils/labels.ts\";\nimport StatusBadge from \"./StatusBadge.tsx\";\n\ninterface OfferTableProps {\n  offers: Offer[];\n  onApply?: (offer: Offer) => void;\n}\n\nconst OfferTable = ({ offers, onApply }: OfferTableProps) => (\n  <div className=\"table-wrapper\">\n    <table className=\"data-table\">\n      <thead>\n        <tr>\n          <th scope=\"col\">Titre</th>\n          <th scope=\"col\">Entreprise</th>\n          <th scope=\"col\">Année</th>\n          <th scope=\"col\">Période</th>\n          <th scope=\"col\">Statut</th>\n          {onApply !== undefined && <th scope=\"col\">Action</th>}\n        </tr>\n      </thead>\n      <tbody>\n        {offers.map((offer) => (\n          <tr key={offer.id}>\n            <td>{offer.title}</td>\n            <td>{offer.companyShortName}</td>\n            <td>{offer.academicYear}</td>\n            <td>{PERIOD_LABELS[offer.period]}</td>\n            <td>\n              <StatusBadge\n                label={OFFER_STATUS_LABELS[offer.status]}\n                tone={OFFER_STATUS_TONES[offer.status]}\n              />\n            </td>\n            {onApply !== undefined && (\n              <td>\n                {offer.status === \"PUBLISHED\" && (\n                  <button className=\"button\" type=\"button\" onClick={() => onApply(offer)}>\n                    Candidater\n                  </button>\n                )}\n              </td>\n            )}\n          </tr>\n        ))}\n      </tbody>\n    </table>\n  </div>\n);\n\nexport default OfferTable;\n",

                "text": "import { useState } from \"react\";\nimport type { ChangeEvent } from \"react\";\r\nimport EmptyState from \"../components/EmptyState.tsx\";\r\nimport ErrorState from \"../components/ErrorState.tsx\";\r\nimport LoadingState from \"../components/LoadingState.tsx\";\r\nimport OfferTable from \"../components/OfferTable.tsx\";\r\nimport { useOffers } from \"../hooks/useOffers.ts\";\r\nimport type { Offer } from \"../models/offer.ts\";\nimport type { PeriodCode } from \"../models/offer.ts\";\r\nimport { createApplication } from \"../services/applications.service.ts\";\nimport { isUnauthorized } from \"../utils/api.ts\";\nimport { isPeriodCode } from \"../utils/guards.ts\";\r\nimport type { User } from \"../models/user.ts\";\r\n\r\ninterface OffersPageProps {\r\n  user: User;\r\n  token: string;\r\n  onUnauthorized: () => void;\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst DESCRIPTIONS = {\r\n  ADMIN: \"Toutes les offres, tous statuts confondus.\",\r\n  STUDENT: \"Les offres publiées.\",\r\n  CONTACT: \"Les offres que vous avez déposées.\",\r\n} as const;\r\n\r\nconst OffersPage = ({ user, token, onUnauthorized }: OffersPageProps) => {\r\n  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<PeriodCode | undefined>();\r\n  const [selectedOfferId, setSelectedOfferId] = useState<number | null>(null);\n  const [message, setMessage] = useState(\"\");\n  const [applicationError, setApplicationError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [applicationNotice, setApplicationNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n  const { offers, isLoading, error } = useOffers(token, onUnauthorized, period);\r\n  const selectedOffer = offers.find((offer) => offer.id === selectedOfferId);\n\r\n  const handlePeriodChange = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {\r\n    const value = event.currentTarget.value;\r\n    setPeriod(isPeriodCode(value) ? value : undefined);\r\n  };\r\n\n  const handleApply = (offer: Offer) => {\n    setSelectedOfferId(offer.id);\n    setMessage(\"\");\n    setApplicationError(null);\n    setApplicationNotice(null);\n  };\n\n  const handleSubmitApplication = async (event: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\n    if (user.kind !== \"STUDENT\" || selectedOffer?.status !== \"PUBLISHED\") return;\n\n    setIsSubmitting(true);\n    setApplicationError(null);\n    try {\n      await createApplication(token, selectedOffer.id, message);\n      setSelectedOfferId(null);\n      setMessage(\"\");\n      setApplicationNotice(\"Votre candidature a été envoyée.\");\n    } catch (reason) {\n      if (isUnauthorized(reason)) {\n        onUnauthorized();\n      } else {\n        setApplicationError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : \"Erreur inconnue\");\n      }\n    } finally {\n      setIsSubmitting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\r\n  const renderContent = () => {\r\n    if (error) return <ErrorState message={error} />;\r\n    if (isLoading) return <LoadingState />;\r\n    if (offers.length === 0) return <EmptyState message=\"Aucune offre à afficher.\" />;\r\n    return (\r\n      <>\r\n        <p className=\"result-count\">\r\n          {offers.length} offre{offers.length > 1 ? \"s\" : \"\"}\r\n        </p>\r\n        <OfferTable offers={offers} onApply={user.kind === \"STUDENT\" ? handleApply : undefined} />\n        {user.kind === \"STUDENT\" && selectedOffer?.status === \"PUBLISHED\" && (\n          <form className=\"application-form\" onSubmit={handleSubmitApplication}>\n            <h2>Candidater à « {selectedOffer.title} »</h2>\n            <label htmlFor=\"application-message\">Message (facultatif, 1000 caractères maximum)</label>\n            <textarea\n              id=\"application-message\"\n              maxLength={1000}\n              value={message}\n              onChange={(event) => setMessage(event.currentTarget.value)}\n            />\n            {applicationError && <ErrorState message={applicationError} />}\n            <button className=\"button button-primary\" type=\"submit\" disabled={isSubmitting}>\n              {isSubmitting ? \"Envoi…\" : \"Envoyer ma candidature\"}\n            </button>\n            <button\n              className=\"button\"\n              type=\"button\"\n              onClick={() => setSelectedOfferId(null)}\n              disabled={isSubmitting}\n            >\n              Annuler\n            </button>\n          </form>\n        )}\n        {applicationNotice && <p className=\"state state-success\">{applicationNotice}</p>}\n      </>\r\n    );\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <section>\r\n      <h1>Offres de stage</h1>\r\n      <p>{DESCRIPTIONS[user.kind]}</p>\r\n      <div className=\"field\">\r\n        <label htmlFor=\"offers-period\">Période</label>\r\n        <select id=\"offers-period\" value={period ?? \"\"} onChange={handlePeriodChange}>\r\n          <option value=\"\">Toutes les périodes</option>\r\n          <option value=\"P1\">P1</option>\r\n          <option value=\"P2\">P2</option>\r\n          <option value=\"OTHER\">Autre</option>\r\n        </select>\r\n      </div>\r\n      {renderContent()}\r\n    </section>\r\n  );\r\n};\r\n\r\nexport default OffersPage;\r\n",

              {
                "text": "import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from \"@testing-library/react\";\r\nimport { describe, expect, it, vi } from \"vitest\";\r\nimport OffersPage from \"../src/pages/OffersPage.tsx\";\r\nimport { adminUser, contactUser, stubFetch, studentUser } from \"./helpers/fetchMock.ts\";\r\n\r\nconst p2Offer = {\r\n  id: 2,\r\n  title: \"Refonte du portail client\",\r\n  companyShortName: \"Lumen Digital\",\r\n  academicYear: \"2026-2027\",\r\n  period: \"P2\",\r\n  status: \"SUBMITTED\",\r\n};\r\n\r\nconst otherOffer = {\r\n  id: 5,\r\n  title: \"Tableau de bord de qualité des données\",\r\n  companyShortName: \"Lumen Data\",\r\n  academicYear: \"2026-2027\",\r\n  period: \"OTHER\",\r\n  status: \"ASSIGNED\",\r\n};\r\n\r\nconst p1Offer = {\r\n  id: 9,\r\n  title: \"Module de rapports PDF\",\r\n  companyShortName: \"Orbis\",\r\n  academicYear: \"2025-2026\",\r\n  period: \"P1\",\r\n  status: \"ARCHIVED\",\r\n};\r\n\nconst publishedOffer = {\n  id: 11,\n  title: \"API de test publiée\",\n  companyShortName: \"Orbis\",\n  academicYear: \"2026-2027\",\n  period: \"P2\",\n  status: \"PUBLISHED\",\n};\n\r\nconst offers = [p2Offer, otherOffer, p1Offer];\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"OffersPage\", () => {\r\n  it(\"affiche les offres avec leurs libellés français\", async () => {\r\n    const fetchMock = stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json(offers) });\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={contactUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n\r\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"Refonte du portail client\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Soumise\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Attribuée\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"option\", { name: \"Autre\" })).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Module de rapports PDF\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"3 offres\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"combobox\", { name: \"Période\" })).toHaveValue(\"\");\r\n    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[0]?.[0]).toBe(\"/api/offers\");\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Les offres que vous avez déposées.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\r\n    [\"P1\", \"P1\", p1Offer.title],\r\n    [\"P2\", \"P2\", p2Offer.title],\r\n    [\"Autre\", \"Autre\", otherOffer.title],\r\n  ])(\"demande les offres de la période %s\", async (label, queryValue, expectedTitle) => {\r\n    const fetchMock = stubFetch({\r\n      \"/api/offers?period=P1\": () => Response.json([p1Offer]),\r\n      \"/api/offers?period=P2\": () => Response.json([p2Offer]),\r\n      \"/api/offers?period=Autre\": () => Response.json([otherOffer]),\r\n      \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json(offers),\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={contactUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n\r\n    await screen.findByText(\"3 offres\");\r\n    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole(\"combobox\", { name: \"Période\" }), {\r\n      target: { value: label === \"Autre\" ? \"OTHER\" : label },\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"1 offre\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(expectedTitle)).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0]).toBe(`/api/offers?period=${queryValue}`);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"adapte la description au profil\", async () => {\r\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([]) });\r\n\r\n    const { unmount } = render(\r\n      <OffersPage user={studentUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />,\r\n    );\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Les offres publiées.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"Aucune offre à afficher.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    unmount();\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={adminUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Toutes les offres, tous statuts confondus.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"affiche un refus d'accès renvoyé par le backend\", async () => {\r\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => new Response(null, { status: 403 }) });\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={contactUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n\r\n    expect(await screen.findByRole(\"alert\")).toHaveTextContent(\"statut 403\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"signale une session expirée\", async () => {\r\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => new Response(null, { status: 401 }) });\r\n    const onUnauthorized = vi.fn();\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={contactUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={onUnauthorized} />);\r\n\r\n    await waitFor(() => expect(onUnauthorized).toHaveBeenCalled());\r\n  });\r\n\n  it(\"permet à un étudiant de candidater à une offre publiée avec un message\", async () => {\n    const fetchMock = stubFetch({\n      \"/api/applications\": () =>\n        Response.json(\n          {\n            id: 12,\n            offerId: publishedOffer.id,\n            message: \"Message test\",\n            status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\n            appliedAt: \"2026-11-09 12:00:00\",\n          },\n          { status: 201 },\n        ),\n      \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([publishedOffer]),\n    });\n\n    render(<OffersPage user={studentUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\n\n    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Candidater\" }));\n    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole(\"textbox\", { name: /Message/ }), {\n      target: { value: \"Message test\" },\n    });\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Envoyer ma candidature\" }));\n\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"Votre candidature a été envoyée.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\n    const call = fetchMock.mock.calls.find(([url]) => url === \"/api/applications\");\n    expect(call?.[1]).toMatchObject({\n      method: \"POST\",\n      headers: { Authorization: \"jeton\", \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\n      body: JSON.stringify({ offerId: publishedOffer.id, message: \"Message test\" }),\n    });\n  });\n\n  it.each([adminUser, contactUser])(\"n'affiche pas l'action de candidature à un non-étudiant\", async (user) => {\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([publishedOffer]) });\n\n    render(<OffersPage user={user} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\n\n    await screen.findByText(publishedOffer.title);\n    expect(screen.queryByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Candidater\" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.queryByRole(\"textbox\", { name: /Message/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it(\"n'affiche pas l'action de candidature pour une offre non publiée\", async () => {\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([p2Offer, publishedOffer]) });\n\n    render(<OffersPage user={studentUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\n\n    await screen.findByText(publishedOffer.title);\n    expect(screen.getAllByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Candidater\" })).toHaveLength(1);\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Candidater\" }));\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"textbox\", { name: /Message/ })).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n});\r\n",

                "text": "import request from \"supertest\";\r\nimport { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\r\nimport { ADMINISTRATOR, CONTACT, OFFER, STUDENT } from \"../src/db/seed/seedIds.ts\";\r\nimport type { Db } from \"../src/db/database.ts\";\r\nimport { createTestApp, tokenFor } from \"./helpers/testApp.ts\";\r\nimport { createTestDatabase } from \"./helpers/testDatabase.ts\";\r\n\r\nlet db: Db;\r\nlet app: ReturnType<typeof createTestApp>;\r\n\r\nbeforeEach(() => {\r\n  db = createTestDatabase();\r\n  app = createTestApp(db);\r\n});\r\n\r\nconst applyAs = (kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\", id: number, body: object) =>\n  request(app)\r\n    .post(\"/applications\")\r\n    .set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, id))\r\n    .send(body);\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : accès\", () => {\r\n  it(\"refuse une requête sans session (401)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await request(app).post(\"/applications\").send({ offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(401);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\r\n    [\"administrateur\", \"ADMIN\" as const, ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ],\r\n    [\"contact déposant\", \"CONTACT\" as const, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE],\r\n  ])(\"refuse une candidature par %s (403)\", async (_profile, kind, id) => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(kind, id, { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : création\", () => {\r\n  it(\"crée une candidature avec un message normalisé\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"  Le sujet m'intéresse.  \",\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\",\r\n      status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n    });\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"id\");\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"appliedAt\");\r\n    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty(\"studentId\");\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\r\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([undefined, \"\", \"   \"])(\"accepte un message vide (%s) et le stocke à NULL\", async (message) => {\r\n    const body = { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, ...(message === undefined ? {} : { message }) };\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, body);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.message).toBeNull();\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT message FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { message: string | null };\r\n    expect(stored.message).toBeNull();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"accepte un message normalisé de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: ` ${\"x\".repeat(1000)} `,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.message).toHaveLength(1000);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"rejette un message normalisé de plus de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"x\".repeat(1001),\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"dérive l'étudiant de la session et ignore tout studentId fourni\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      studentId: STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\r\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : refus\", () => {\r\n  it(\"rejette un corps invalide\", async () => {\r\n    const response expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"renvoie 404 pour une offre inexistante\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, { offerId: 999 });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(404);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"NOT_FOUND\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"refuse une offre existante qui n'est pas publiée (409)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.CLIENT_PORTAL,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(409);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\"IN_PROGRESS\", \"SELECTED\", \"REJECTED\"] as const)(\r\n    \"refuse une candidature déjà existante au statut %s\",\r\n    async (status) => {\r\n      if (status !== \"IN_PROGRESS\") {\r\n        db.prepare(\r\n          \"INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\r\n        ).run(OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, status);\r\n      }\r\n      const offerId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? OFFER.FLEET_APP : OFFER.DATA_QUALITY;\r\n      const studentId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT : STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO;\r\n\r\n      const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", studentId, { offerId });\r\n\r\n      expect(response.status).toBe(409);\r\n      expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"APPLICATION_EXISTS\");\r\n    },\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  it(\"permet de candidater à nouveau après une candidature retirée\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD, { offerId: OFFER.BILLING_API });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.status).toBe(\"IN_PROGRESS\");\r\n  });\r\n});",

          "edits": [

              {
                "text": "import { vi } from \"vitest\";\nimport type { User } from \"../../src/models/user.ts\";\n\ntype Responder = () => Response;\n\n/**\n * Remplace fetch par des réponses choisies selon le début de l'URL appelée.\n * Chaque appel crée une nouvelle Response : son corps ne se lit qu'une fois.\n */\nexport const stubFetch = (routes: Record<string, Responder>) => {\n  const fetchMock = vi.fn((input: RequestInfo | URL, _init?: RequestInit) => {\n    const url = String(input);\n    const prefix = Object.keys(routes)\n      .sort((a, b) => b.length - a.length)\n      .find((candidate) => url.startsWith(candidate));\n    const responder = prefix === undefined ? undefined : routes[prefix];\n    return Promise.resolve(responder ? responder() : new Response(null, { status: 404 }));\n  });\n  vi.stubGlobal(\"fetch\", fetchMock);\n  return fetchMock;\n};\n\nexport const studentUser: User = {\n  kind: \"STUDENT\",\n  id: 3,\n  firstName: \"Mateusz\",\n  lastName: \"Kowalski\",\n  email: \"mateusz.kowalski@etu.gesta.test\",\n  roles: [],\n  companies: [],\n};\n\nexport const contactUser: User = {\n  kind: \"CONTACT\",\n  id: 4,\n  firstName: \"Julien\",\n  lastName: \"Lambert\",\n  email: \"julien.lambert@lumen.test\",\n  roles: [\"DEPOSITOR\", \"PROMOTER\"],\n  companies: [\n    { id: 3, shortName: \"Lumen Data\" },\n    { id: 2, shortName: \"Lumen Digital\" },\n  ],\n};\n\nexport const adminUser: User = {\n  kind: \"ADMIN\",\n  id: 1,\n  firstName: \"Anne\",\n  lastName: \"Leclercq\",\n  email: \"anne.leclercq@gesta.test\",\n  roles: [],\n  companies: [],\n};\n\nexport const promoterUser: User = {\n  kind: \"CONTACT\",\n  id: 3,\n  firstName: \"Nadia\",\n  lastName: \"Cherif\",\n  email: \"nadia.cherif@orbis.test\",\n  roles: [\"PROMOTER\", \"SIGNATORY\"],\n  companies: [{ id: 4, shortName: \"Orbis\" }],\n};\n",

Retirer une candidature non traitée\n    26\t- Backend : ajouter `PATCH /applications/:applicationId/withdraw` sans corps. Valider l’identifiant positif; dériver l’étudiant de `req.user`. La modification est un changement à `WITHDRAWN`, jamais une suppression, et ne réussit que si la candidature appartient à l’étudiant et est encore `IN_PROGRESS`. Utiliser une mise à jour conditionnelle en repository pour éviter le retrait concurrent d’un statut déjà changé. Candidature absente ou appartenant à un autre étudiant : `404` (ne pas révéler son existence); candidature propre en `SELECTED`, `REJECTED` ou `WITHDRAWN` : `409`; rôle non étudiant : `403`.\n    27\t- Frontend : ajouter dans `frontend/src/pages/ApplicationsPage.tsx` le bouton de retrait uniquement pour `IN_PROGRESS`, appeler le service, puis rafraîchir ou mettre à jour l’état. Afficher l’état et les erreurs avec les composants existants.\n    28\t- Tests backend : retrait propre d’une candidature en cours, ligne et message historiques conservés, statut `WITHDRAWN`; retrait refusé pour `SELECTED`, `REJECTED`, `WITHDRAWN`; étudiant tiers et id inexistant donnent `404`; rôle non étudiant `403`; après retrait, une nouvelle candidature sur la même offre est créée avec un nouvel id et l’historique contient les deux lignes. Tests dans `backend/tests/applications.test.ts`.\n    29\t- Tests frontend : bouton présent seulement pour `IN_PROGRESS`; action met à jour le statut sans retirer la ligne; erreurs `409` affichées et autres statuts non mutables. Compléter `frontend/tests/ApplicationsPage.test.tsx`.\n    30\t- Vérification manuelle : retirer une candidature en cours d’un compte démo, recharger et confirmer « Retirée » reste visible, puis recandidater depuis `/offres` et constater deux entrées historiques distinctes. Vérifier qu’aucun bouton n’est présenté pour les candidatures sélectionnées/non retenues et que l’API refuse les tentatives.\n    31\t- Commit autonome suggéré : `feat: allow students to withdraw applications` (dépend des étapes 1 et 2).\n    32\t\n    33\t**Fichiers de référence**\n    34\t- `docs/cdc_gesta_developpement.md` — EF-32, EF-33, EF-35, RG-03, EF-72, ENF-03 et ENF-04.\n    35\t- `docs/architecture.md` — couches et exemple bout en bout à suivre.\n    36\t- `backend/API.md` — contrat et format d’erreur à étendre.\n    37\t- `backend/src/db/migrations/001_initial.sql` — colonnes et statuts existants de `applications`; migration existante immuable.\n    38\t- `docs/seed.md`, `backend/src/db/seed/offersData.ts` — comptes, offres et candidatures de démonstration pour les scénarios manuels.\n    39\t- Références de code : `backend/src/services/permissions.ts`, `backend/src/controllers/offers.controller.ts`, `backend/src/services/offers.service.ts`, `backend/src/repositories/offers.repository.ts`, `backend/src/middlewares/authenticate.ts`, `frontend/src/pages/OffersPage.tsx`, `frontend/src/App.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/NavBar.tsx`, `frontend/src/utils/labels.ts`.\n    40\t\n    41\t**Vérification**\n    42\t1. À chaque étape, lancer le test backend concerné avec `npm run test -w backend -- tests/applications.test.ts` et les tests DB concernés; lancer le test frontend concerné avec `npm run test -w frontend -- tests/OffersPage.test.tsx` ou `npm run test -w frontend -- tests/ApplicationsPage.test.tsx`.\n    43\t2. Pour chaque commit, exécuter au minimum `npm run typecheck`; avant intégration finale exécuter `npm run check` depuis la racine (lint, typecheck, tests, build).\n    44\t3. Effectuer les scénarios démo décrits dans chaque étape en plus des tests automatisés.\n    45\t\n    46\t**Décisions**\n    47\t- Uniquement un étudiant peut créer, consulter et retirer ses candidatures; toute vérification d’accès se fait côté serveur via une règle nommée de `permissions.ts`.\n    48\t- Seules les offres `PUBLISHED` sont éligibles; offre absente `404`, offre existante non publiée `409`.\n    49\t- Toute candidature dont le statut n’est pas `WITHDRAWN` bloque un doublon, y compris `SELECTED` et `REJECTED`; appliquer la même règle dans le service et l’index partiel. Après retrait, une nouvelle ligne est créée; l’ancienne reste historique.\n    50\t- Le message est normalisé par `trim`; vide/blanc devient `null`; le maximum de 1000 caractères s’applique au texte normalisé.\n    51\t- Le retrait est permis uniquement depuis `IN_PROGRESS`, passe à `WITHDRAWN` sans suppression; statuts incompatibles `409`.\n    52\t- Toute ressource non détenue ou absente au retrait renvoie `404` pour éviter l’énumération; les ids de candidature peuvent figurer dans l’action URL, jamais une identité personnelle.\n    53\t- Routes retenues : `POST /applications`, `GET /applications/me`, `PATCH /applications/:applicationId/withdraw`.\n    54\t- EF-72 est explicitement une limite de ce travail : pas de filtrage année en cours, les candidatures et offres restent multi-années.\n    55\t- Liste ordonnée du plus récent au plus ancien (`applied_at DESC`, puis `id DESC`). Les connexions de démonstration existantes servent aux essais manuels.\n    56\t- Hors périmètre : EF-30, EF-31, EF-34, sélection d’un candidat, création de stage et toute notification EF-35."
                }
              ]

                "text": "import { fireEvent, render, screen, waitFor } from \"@testing-library/react\";\r\nimport { describe, expect, it, vi } from \"vitest\";\r\nimport OffersPage from \"../src/pages/OffersPage.tsx\";\r\nimport { adminUser, contactUser, stubFetch, studentUser } from \"./helpers/fetchMock.ts\";\r\n\r\nconst p2Offer = {\r\n  id: 2,\r\n  title: \"Refonte du portail client\",\r\n  companyShortName: \"Lumen Digital\",\r\n  academicYear: \"2026-2027\",\r\n  period: \"P2\",\r\n  status: \"SUBMITTED\",\r\n};\r\n\r\nconst otherOffer = {\r\n  id: 5,\r\n  title: \"Tableau de bord de qualité des données\",\r\n  companyShortName: \"Lumen Data\",\r\n  academicYear: \"2026-2027\",\r\n  period: \"OTHER\",\r\n  status: \"ASSIGNED\",\r\n};\r\n\r\nconst p1Offer = {\r\n  id: 9,\r\n  title: \"Module de rapports PDF\",\r\n  companyShortName: \"Orbis\",\r\n  academicYear: \"2025-2026\",\r\n  period: \"P1\",\r\n  status: \"ARCHIVED\",\r\n};\r\n\r\nconst publishedOffer = {\r\n  id: 11,\r\n  title: \"API de test publiée\",\r\n  companyShortName: \"Orbis\",\r\n  academicYear: \"2026-2027\",\r\n  period: \"P2\",\r\n  status: \"PUBLISHED\",\r\n};\r\n\r\nconst offers = [p2Offer, otherOffer, p1Offer];\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"OffersPage\", () => {\r\n  it(\"affiche les offres avec leurs libellés français\", async () => {\r\n    const fetchMock = stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json(offers) });\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={contactUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n\r\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"Refonte du portail client\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Soumise\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Attribuée\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"option\", { name: \"Autre\" })).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Module de rapports PDF\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"3 offres\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"combobox\", { name: \"Période\" })).toHaveValue(\"\");\r\n    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls[0]?.[0]).toBe(\"/api/offers\");\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Les offres que vous avez déposées.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\r\n    [\"P1\", \"P1\", p1Offer.title],\r\n    [\"P2\", \"P2\", p2Offer.title],\r\n    [\"Autre\", \"Autre\", otherOffer.title],\r\n  ])(\"demande les offres de la période %s\", async (label, queryValue, expectedTitle) => {\r\n    const fetchMock = stubFetch({\r\n      \"/api/offers?period=P1\": () => Response.json([p1Offer]),\r\n      \"/api/offers?period=P2\": () => Response.json([p2Offer]),\r\n      \"/api/offers?period=Autre\": () => Response.json([otherOffer]),\r\n      \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json(offers),\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={contactUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n\r\n    await screen.findByText(\"3 offres\");\r\n    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole(\"combobox\", { name: \"Période\" }), {\r\n      target: { value: label === \"Autre\" ? \"OTHER\" : label },\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"1 offre\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(expectedTitle)).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(fetchMock.mock.calls.at(-1)?.[0]).toBe(`/api/offers?period=${queryValue}`);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"adapte la description au profil\", async () => {\r\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([]) });\r\n\r\n    const { unmount } = render(\r\n      <OffersPage user={studentUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />,\r\n    );\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Les offres publiées.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"Aucune offre à afficher.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    unmount();\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={adminUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n    expect(screen.getByText(\"Toutes les offres, tous statuts confondus.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"affiche un refus d'accès renvoyé par le backend\", async () => {\r\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => new Response(null, { status: 403 }) });\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={contactUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n\r\n    expect(await screen.findByRole(\"alert\")).toHaveTextContent(\"statut 403\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"signale une session expirée\", async () => {\r\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => new Response(null, { status: 401 }) });\r\n    const onUnauthorized = vi.fn();\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={contactUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={onUnauthorized} />);\r\n\r\n    await waitFor(() => expect(onUnauthorized).toHaveBeenCalled());\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"permet à un étudiant de candidater à une offre publiée avec un message\", async () => {\r\n    const fetchMock = stubFetch({\r\n      \"/api/applications\": () =>\r\n        Response.json(\r\n          {\r\n            id: 12,\r\n            offerId: publishedOffer.id,\r\n            message: \"Message test\",\r\n            status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n            appliedAt: \"2026-11-09 12:00:00\",\r\n          },\r\n          { status: 201 },\r\n        ),\r\n      \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([publishedOffer]),\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={studentUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n\r\n    fireEvent.click(await screen.findByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Candidater\" }));\r\n    fireEvent.change(screen.getByRole(\"textbox\", { name: /Message/ }), {\r\n      target: { value: \"Message test\" },\r\n    });\r\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Envoyer ma candidature\" }));\r\n\r\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"Votre candidature a été envoyée.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n    const call = fetchMock.mock.calls.find(([url]) => url === \"/api/applications\");\r\n    expect(call?.[1]).toMatchObject({\r\n      method: \"POST\",\r\n      headers: { Authorization: \"jeton\", \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\" },\r\n      body: JSON.stringify({ offerId: publishedOffer.id, message: \"Message test\" }),\r\n    });\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\n    [\"administrateur\", adminUser],\n    [\"contact déposant\", contactUser],\n  ])(\"n'affiche pas l'action de candidature à un %s\", async (_profile, user) => {\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([publishedOffer]) });\n\n    render(<OffersPage user={user} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\n\n    await screen.findByText(publishedOffer.title);\n    expect(screen.queryByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Candidater\" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.queryByRole(\"textbox\", { name: /Message/ })).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\r\n  it(\"n'affiche pas l'action de candidature pour une offre non publiée\", async () => {\r\n    stubFetch({ \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([p2Offer, publishedOffer]) });\r\n\r\n    render(<OffersPage user={studentUser} token=\"jeton\" onUnauthorized={vi.fn()} />);\r\n\r\n    await screen.findByText(publishedOffer.title);\r\n    expect(screen.getAllByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Candidater\" })).toHaveLength(1);\r\n    fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole(\"button\", { name: \"Candidater\" }));\r\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"textbox\", { name: /Message/ })).toBeInTheDocument();\r\n  });\r\n\n  it(\"permet à un étudiant de candidater sans message\", async () => {\n    const fetchMock = stubFetch({\n      \"/api/applications\": () =>\n        Response.json(\n          {\n            id: 13,\n            offerId: publishedOffer.id,\n            message: null,\n            status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\n            appliedAt: \"2026-11-09 12:00:00\",\n          },\n          { status: 201 },\n        ),\n      \"/api/offers\": () => Response.json([publishedOffer]),\n    });\n\n    render(<OffersPage user={studentUser} token=\"jeton\" candidature\" }));\n\n    expect(await screen.findByText(\"Votre candidature a été envoyée.\")).toBeInTheDocument();\n    const call = fetchMock.mock.calls.find(([url]) => url ===             "scheme": "file"

          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "import { useState } from \"react\";\nimport type { Offer } from \"../models/offer.ts\";\nimport { createApplication } from \"../services/applications.service.ts\";\nimport { isUnauthorized } from \"../utils/api.ts\";\n\nexport const useApplyToOffer = (\n  token: string,\n  onUnauthorized: () => void,\n  canApply: boolean,\n) => {\n  const [selectedOfferId, setSelectedOfferId] = useState<number | null>(null);\n  const [message, setMessage] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);\n\n  const selectOffer = (offerId: number) => {\n    setSelectedOfferId(offerId);\n    setMessage(\"\");\n    setError(null);\n    setNotice(null);\n  };\n\n  const submitApplication = async (offer: Offer | undefined) => {\n    if (!canApply || offer?.status !== \"PUBLISHED\") return;\n\n    setIsSubmitting(true);\n    setError(null);\n    try {\n      await createApplication(token, offer.id, message);\n      setSelectedOfferId(null);\n      setMessage(\"\");\n      setNotice(\"Votre candidature a été envoyée.\");\n    } catch (reason) {\n      if (isUnauthorized(reason)) {\n        onUnauthorized();\n      } else {\n        setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : \"Erreur inconnue\");\n      }\n    } finally {\n      setIsSubmitting(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return {\n    selectedOfferId,\n    message,\n    error,\n    notice,\n    isSubmitting,\n    selectOffer,\n    setMessage,\n    submitApplication,\n    cancelApplication: () => setSelectedOfferId(null),\n  };\n};",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 1,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }
            ],
            []
          ],

          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "import { useState } from \"react\";\r\nimport type { ChangeEvent, FormEvent } from \"react\";\nimport EmptyState from \"../components/EmptyState.tsx\";\r\nimport ErrorState from \"../components/ErrorState.tsx\";\r\nimport LoadingState from \"../components/LoadingState.tsx\";\r\nimport OfferTable from \"../components/OfferTable.tsx\";\r\nimport { useApplyToOffer } from \"../hooks/useApplyToOffer.ts\";\nimport { useOffers } from \"../hooks/useOffers.ts\";\r\nimport type { Offer, PeriodCode } from \"../models/offer.ts\";\nimport { isPeriodCode } from \"../utils/guards.ts\";\r\nimport type { User } from \"../models/user.ts\";\r\n\r\ninterface OffersPageProps {\r\n  user: User;\r\n  token: string;\r\n  onUnauthorized: () => void;\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst DESCRIPTIONS = {\r\n  ADMIN: \"Toutes les offres, tous statuts confondus.\",\r\n  STUDENT: \"Les offres publiées.\",\r\n  CONTACT: \"Les offres que vous avez déposées.\",\r\n} as const;\r\n\r\nconst OffersPage = ({ user, token, onUnauthorized }: OffersPageProps) => {\r\n  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<PeriodCode | undefined>();\r\n  const { offers, isLoading, error } = useOffers(token, onUnauthorized, period);\r\n  const application = useApplyToOffer(token, onUnauthorized, user.kind === \"STUDENT\");\n  const {\n    selectedOfferId,\n    message,\n    error: applicationError,\n    notice: applicationNotice,\n    isSubmitting,\n    selectOffer,\n    setMessage,\n    submitApplication,\n    cancelApplication,\n  } = application;\n  const selectedOffer = offers.find((offer) => offer.id === selectedOfferId);\r\n\r\n  const handlePeriodChange = (event: ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {\r\n    const value = event.currentTarget.value;\r\n    setPeriod(isPeriodCode(value) ? value : undefined);\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  const handleApply = (offer: Offer) => selectOffer(offer.id);\n\r\n  const handleSubmitApplication = (event: FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {\n    event.preventDefault();\r\n    void submitApplication(selectedOffer);\n  };\r\n\r\n  const renderContent = () => {\r\n    if (error) return <ErrorState message={error} />;\r\n    if (isLoading) return <LoadingState />;\r\n    if (offers.length === 0) return <EmptyState message=\"Aucune offre à afficher.\" />;\r\n    return (\r\n      <>\r\n        <p className=\"result-count\">\r\n          {offers.length} offre{offers.length > 1 ? \"s\" : \"\"}\r\n        </p>\r\n        <OfferTable offers={offers} onApply={user.kind === \"STUDENT\" ? handleApply : undefined} />\r\n        {user.kind === \"STUDENT\" && selectedOffer?.status === \"PUBLISHED\" && (\r\n          <form className=\"application-form\" onSubmit={handleSubmitApplication}>\r\n            <h2>Candidater à « {selectedOffer.title} »</h2>\r\n            <label htmlFor=\"application-message\">Message (facultatif, 1000 caractères maximum)</label>\r\n            <textarea\r\n              id=\"application-message\"\r\n              maxLength={1000}\r\n              value={message}\r\n              onChange={(event) => setMessage(event.currentTarget.value)}\r\n            />\r\n            {applicationError && <ErrorState message={applicationError} />}\r\n            <button className=\"button button-primary\" type=\"submit\" disabled={isSubmitting}>\r\n              {isSubmitting ? \"Envoi…\" : \"Envoyer ma candidature\"}\r\n            </button>\r\n            <button\r\n              className=\"button\"\r\n              type=\"button\"\r\n              onClick={cancelApplication}\n              disabled={isSubmitting}\r\n            >\r\n              Annuler\r\n            </button>\r\n          </form>\r\n        )}\r\n        {applicationNotice && <p className=\"state state-success\">{applicationNotice}</p>}\r\n      </>\r\n    );\r\n  };\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <section>\r\n      <h1>Offres de stage</h1>\r\n      <p>{DESCRIPTIONS[user.kind]}</p>\r\n      <div className=\"field\">\r\n        <label htmlFor=\"offers-period\">Période</label>\r\n        <select id=\"offers-period\" value={period ?? \"\"} onChange={handlePeriodChange}>\r\n          <option value=\"\">Toutes les périodes</option>\r\n          <option value=\"P1\">P1</option>\r\n          <option value=\"P2\">P2</option>\r\n          <option value=\"OTHER\">Autre</option>\r\n        </select>\r\n      </div>\r\n      {renderContent()}\r\n    </section>\r\n  );\r\n};\r\n\r\nexport default OffersPage;\r\n",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,

                  "endLineNumber": 113,

                "text": "import type {\n  Application,\n  ApplicationDbo,\n  ApplicationDto,\n  ApplicationListDbo,\n  ApplicationListItem,\n  ApplicationListItemDto,\n} from \"../models/application.ts\";\n\r\nexport const toApplication = (dbo: ApplicationDbo): Application => ({\r\n  id: dbo.id,\r\n  offerId: dbo.offer_id,\r\n  message: dbo.message,\r\n  status: dbo.status,\r\n  appliedAt: dbo.applied_at,\r\n});\r\n\r\nexport const toApplicationDto = (application: Application): ApplicationDto => ({\r\n  id: application.id,\r\n  offerId: application.offerId,\r\n  message: application.message,\r\n  status: application.status,\r\n  appliedAt: application.appliedAt,\r\n});\n\nexport const toApplicationListItem = (dbo: ApplicationListDbo): ApplicationListItem => ({\n  ...toApplication(dbo),\n  offerTitle: dbo.offer_title,\n  companyShortName: dbo.company_short_name,\n  academicYear: dbo.academic_year_label,\n  period: dbo.period_code,\n});\n\nexport const toApplicationListItemDto = (\n  application: ApplicationListItem,\n): ApplicationListItemDto => ({ ...application });",

              {
                "text": "import type { Db } from \"../db/database.ts\";\r\nimport type { ApplicationDbo, ApplicationListDbo } from \"../models/application.ts\";\nimport type { OfferStatus } from \"../models/offer.ts\";\r\n\r\ninterface OfferStatusRow {\r\n  status: OfferStatus;\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface ApplicationParams {\r\n  offerId: number;\r\n  studentId: number;\r\n  message: string | null;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport const createApplicationsRepository = (db: Db) => {\r\n  const findOfferStatus = db.prepare<{ offerId: number }, OfferStatusRow>(\r\n    \"SELECT status FROM offers WHERE id = @offerId\",\r\n  );\r\n  const findActive = db.prepare<{ offerId: number; studentId: number }, { id: number }>(`\r\n    SELECT id FROM applications\r\n    WHERE offer_id = @offerId AND student_id = @studentId AND status <> 'WITHDRAWN'\r\n    LIMIT 1\r\n  `);\r\n  const insertApplication = db.prepare<ApplicationParams>(`\r\n    INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id, message)\r\n    VALUES (@offerId, @studentId, @message)\r\n  `);\r\n  const findById = db.prepare<{ id: number }, ApplicationDbo>(`\r\n    SELECT id, offer_id, student_id, message, status, applied_at\r\n    FROM applications WHERE id = @id\r\n  `);\r\n  const findByStudentId = db.prepare<{ studentId: number }, ApplicationListDbo>(`\n    SELECT a.id, a.offer_id, a.student_id, a.message, a.status, a.applied_at,\n           o.title AS offer_title, c.short_name AS company_short_name,\n           ay.label AS academic_year_label, p.code AS period_code\n    FROM applications a\n    JOIN offers o ON o.id = a.offer_id\n    JOIN companies c ON c.id = o.company_id\n    JOIN academic_years ay ON ay.id = o.academic_year_id\n    JOIN periods p ON p.id = o.period_id\n    WHERE a.student_id = @studentId\n    ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC, a.id DESC\n  `);\n\r\n  return {\r\n    findOfferStatus: (offerId: number): OfferStatus | undefined =>\r\n      findOfferStatus.get({ offerId })?.status,\r\n    hasActiveForOffer: (offerId: number, studentId: number): boolean =>\r\n      findActive.get({ offerId, studentId }) !== undefined,\r\n    findAllForStudent: (studentId: number): ApplicationListDbo[] =>\n      findByStudentId.all({ studentId }),\n    create: (params: ApplicationParams): ApplicationDbo => {\r\n      const result = insertApplication.run(params);\r\n      const application = findById.get({ id: Number(result.lastInsertRowid) });\r\n      if (application === undefined) throw new Error(\"Candidature créée introuvable\");\r\n      return application;\r\n    },\r\n  };\r\n};\r\n\r\nexport type ApplicationsRepository = ReturnType<typeof createApplicationsRepository>;",

              {
                "text": "import type { ContactRole, User } from \"../models/user.ts\";\n\n// Règles d'accès du CdC (§ 4), indépendantes d'Express. Les contrôleurs les appliquent\n// avec le middleware authorize ; les services s'en servent pour filtrer les données.\n\nexport const isAdmin = (user: User): boolean => user.kind === \"ADMIN\";\n\nexport const isStudent = (user: User): boolean => user.kind === \"STUDENT\";\n\nexport const canApplyToOffers = (user: User): boolean => isStudent(user);\n\nexport const canViewOwnApplications = (user: User): boolean => isStudent(user);\n\n/** Les rôles d'un contact s'exercent dans toutes ses entreprises. */\nexport const hasContactRole = (user: User, role: ContactRole): boolean =>\n  user.kind === \"CONTACT\" && user.roles.includes(role);\n\n/**\n * Consulter des offres : l'administrateur, l'étudiant et le déposant. Un contact\n * seulement promoteur ou signataire n'y a pas accès.\n */\nexport const canListOffers = (user: User): boolean =>\n  isAdmin(user) || isStudent(user) || hasContactRole(user, \"DEPOSITOR\");\n",

                "text": "import { toApplication, toApplicationListItem } from \"../mappers/application.mapper.ts\";\nimport type { Application, ApplicationListItem } from \"../models/application.ts\";\nimport type { User } from \"../models/user.ts\";\r\nimport type { ApplicationsRepository } from \"../repositories/applications.repository.ts\";\r\nimport { HttpError } from \"../utils/httpError.ts\";\r\nimport { canApplyToOffers, canViewOwnApplications } from \"./permissions.ts\";\n\r\nconst MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 1000;\r\n\r\nconst isUniqueConstraintError = (error: unknown): boolean =>\r\n  typeof error === \"object\" &&\r\n  error !== null &&\r\n  \"code\" in error &&\r\n  error.code === \"SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE\";\r\n\r\nexport const createApplicationsService = (repository: ApplicationsRepository) => ({\r\n  listOwnApplications: (student: User): ApplicationListItem[] => {\n    if (!canViewOwnApplications(student)) {\n      throw new HttpError(403, \"FORBIDDEN\", \"Seul un étudiant peut consulter ses candidatures\");\n    }\n    return repository.findAllForStudent(student.id).map(toApplicationListItem);\n  },\n\n  applyToOffer: (student: User, offerId: number, message?: string): Application => {\r\n    if (!canApplyToOffers(student)) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(403, \"FORBIDDEN\", \"Seul un étudiant peut candidater\");\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const offerStatus = repository.findOfferStatus(offerId);\r\n    if (offerStatus === undefined) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(404, \"NOT_FOUND\", \"Offre introuvable\");\r\n    }\r\n    if (offerStatus !== \"PUBLISHED\") {\r\n      throw new HttpError(409, \"OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED\", \"Cette offre n'est pas publiée\");\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const normalizedMessage = message?.trim() || null;\r\n    if (normalizedMessage !== null && normalizedMessage.length > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(\r\n        400,\r\n        \"INVALID_BODY\",\r\n        `Le message ne peut pas dépasser ${MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH} caractères`,\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    if (repository.hasActiveForOffer(offerId, student.id)) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(409, \"APPLICATION_EXISTS\", \"Vous avez déjà candidaté à cette offre\");\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    try {\r\n      return toApplication(\r\n        repository.create({ offerId, studentId: student.id, message: normalizedMessage }),\r\n      );\r\n    } catch (error) {\r\n      if (isUniqueConstraintError(error)) {\r\n        throw new HttpError(409, \"APPLICATION_EXISTS\", \"Vous avez déjà candidaté à cette offre\");\r\n      }\r\n      throw error;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n});\r\n\r\nexport type ApplicationsService = ReturnType<typeof createApplicationsService>;",

                "text": "import { Router } from \"express\";\r\nimport { toApplicationDto, toApplicationListItemDto } from \"../mappers/application.mapper.ts\";\nimport { getCurrentUser } from \"../middlewares/authenticate.ts\";\r\nimport { authorize } from \"../middlewares/authorize.ts\";\r\nimport type { ApplicationsService } from \"../services/applications.service.ts\";\r\nimport { canApplyToOffers, canViewOwnApplications } from \"../services/permissions.ts\";\nimport { HttpError } from \"../utils/httpError.ts\";\r\n\r\ninterface CreateApplicationBody {\r\n  offerId: number;\r\n  message?: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst isCreateApplicationBody = (value: unknown): value is CreateApplicationBody => {\r\n  if (typeof value !== \"object\" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;\r\n  const body = value as Record<string, unknown>;\r\n  return (\r\n    typeof body.offerId === \"number\" &&\r\n    Number.isInteger(body.offerId) &&\r\n    body.offerId > 0 &&\r\n    (body.message === undefined || typeof body.message === \"string\")\r\n  );\r\n};\r\n\r\nexport const createApplicationsRouter = (applicationsService: ApplicationsService) => {\r\n  const router = Router();\r\n\r\n  router.get(\"/me\", authorize(canViewOwnApplications), (req, res) => {\n    const applications = applicationsService.listOwnApplications(getCurrentUser(req));\n    res.json(applications.map(toApplicationListItemDto));\n  });\n\n  router.post(\"/\", authorize(canApplyToOffers), (req, res) => {\r\n    const body: unknown = req.body;\r\n    if (!isCreateApplicationBody(body)) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(\r\n        400,\r\n        \"INVALID_BODY\",\r\n        \"Le corps doit contenir offerId (entier positif) et un message facultatif\",\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const application = applicationsService.applyToOffer(\r\n      getCurrentUser(req),\r\n      body.offerId,\r\n      body.message,\r\n    );\r\n    res.status(201).json(toApplicationDto(application));\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  return router;\r\n};",

                "text": "import request from \"supertest\";\r\nimport { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\r\nimport { ADMINISTRATOR, APPLICATION, CONTACT, OFFER, STUDENT } from
