.set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, id))\r\n    .send(body);\r\n\nconst listAs = (kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\", id: number) =>\n  request(app).get(\"/applications/me\").set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, id));\n\ndescribe(\"GET /applications/me : accès et isolation\", () => {\n  it(\"refuse une requête sans session (401)\", async () => {\n    const response = await request(app).get(\"/applications/me\");\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(401);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [\"administrateur\", \"ADMIN\" as const, ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ],\n    [\"contact déposant\", \"CONTACT\" as const, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE],\n  ])(\"refuse la consultation par un %s (403)\", async (_profile, kind, id) => {\n    const response = await listAs(kind, id);\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"retourne uniquement les candidatures de l'étudiant connecté\", async () => {\n    const response = await listAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD);\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\n    expect(response.body.map((application: { id: number }) => application.id)).toEqual([\n      APPLICATION.INES_FLEET_APP,\n      APPLICATION.INES_BILLING_API,\n    ]);\n    expect(response.body.every((application: { offerTitle: string }) =>\n      typeof application.offerTitle === \"string\",\n    )).toBe(true);\n    expect(response.body[0]).toMatchObject({\n      offerId: OFFER.FLEET_APP,\n      offerTitle: \"Application React de gestion de flotte\",\n      companyShortName: \"Lumen Digital\",\n      academicYear: \"2026-2027\",\n      period: \"P2\",\n      status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\n    });\n    expect(response.body[0]).not.toHaveProperty(\"studentId\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"ne révèle pas les candidatures d'un autre étudiant\", async () => {\n    const response = await listAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.YOUSSEF_EL_AMRANI);\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\n    expect(response.body).toHaveLength(1);\n    expect(response.body[0].id).toBe(APPLICATION.YOUSSEF_BILLING_API);\n  });\n\n  it(\"retourne une liste vide pour un étudiant sans candidature\", async () => {\n    const response = await listAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO);\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\n    expect(response.body).toEqual([]);\n  });\n});\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : accès\", () => {\r\n  it(\"refuse une requête sans session (401)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await request(app).post(\"/applications\").send({ offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(401);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\r\n    [\"administrateur\", \"ADMIN\" as const, ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ],\r\n    [\"contact déposant\", \"CONTACT\" as const, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE],\r\n  ])(\"refuse une candidature par %s (403)\", async (_profile, kind, id) => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(kind, id, { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : création\", () => {\r\n  it(\"crée une candidature avec un message normalisé\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"  Le sujet m'intéresse.  \",\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\",\r\n      status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n    });\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"id\");\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"appliedAt\");\r\n    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty(\"studentId\");\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\r\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([undefined, \"\", \"   \"])(\"accepte un message vide (%s) et le stocke à NULL\", async (message) => {\r\n    const body = { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, ...(message === undefined ? {} : { message }) };\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, body);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.message).toBeNull();\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT message FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { message: string | null };\r\n    expect(stored.message).toBeNull();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"accepte un message normalisé de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: ` ${\"x\".repeat(1000)} `,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.message).toHaveLength(1000);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"rejette un message normalisé de plus de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"x\".repeat(1001),\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"dérive l'étudiant de la session et ignore tout studentId fourni\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      studentId: STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\r\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : refus\", () => {\r\n  it(\"rejette un corps invalide\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: 0,\r\n      message: 12,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"renvoie 404 pour une offre inexistante\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, { offerId: 999 });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(404);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"NOT_FOUND\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"refuse une offre existante qui n'est pas publiée (409)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.CLIENT_PORTAL,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(409);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\"IN_PROGRESS\", \"SELECTED\", \"REJECTED\"] as const)(\r\n    \"refuse une candidature déjà existante au statut %s\",\r\n    async (status) => {\r\n      if (status !== \"IN_PROGRESS\") {\r\n        db.prepare(\r\n          \"INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\r\n        ).run(OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, status);\r\n      }\r\n      const offerId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? OFFER.FLEET_APP : OFFER.DATA_QUALITY;\r\n      const studentId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT : STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO;\r\n\r\n      const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", studentId, { offerId });\r\n\r\n      expect(response.status).toBe(409);\r\n      expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"APPLICATION_EXISTS\");\r\n    },\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  it(\"permet de candidater à nouveau après une candidature retirée\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD, { offerId: OFFER.BILLING_API });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.status).toBe(\"IN_PROGRESS\");\r\n  });\r\n});",

                "text": "# API Gesta\r\n\r\nToutes les réponses sont en JSON. En développement, le frontend appelle `/api/...` et le\r\nproxy Vite transmet la requête au backend sans le préfixe `/api`.\r\n\r\nLes requêtes d'exemple se trouvent dans `http/` (extension REST Client de VS Code).\r\n\r\n## Authentification\r\n\r\nLes routes protégées exigent l'en-tête `Authorization` contenant le jeton obtenu à la\r\nconnexion (sans préfixe). Le jeton ne contient que l'identité (`kind`, `id`) ; à chaque\r\nrequête, le backend relit en base le compte, ses rôles et ses entreprises. Un compte\r\ndésactivé, ou un contact sans rôle, ne peut plus accéder à l'API.\r\n\r\n> **Mode démo.** La connexion réelle par lien envoyé par e-mail (CdC EF-01) n'est pas\r\n> implémentée. En développement local, `DEMO_AUTH_ENABLED=true` permet de se connecter\r\n> **sans mot de passe** sous un utilisateur fictif. Ce n'est pas une authentification :\r\n> le serveur refuse de démarrer avec ce mode si `NODE_ENV=production`.\r\n\r\n## Format des erreurs\r\n\r\nToute erreur a la même forme :\r\n\r\n```json\r\n{ \"error\": { \"code\": \"INVALID_QUERY\", \"message\": \"Le paramètre q doit apparaître une seule fois\" } }\r\n```\r\n\r\n| Statut | Code | Cas |\r\n|---|---|---|\r\n| 400 | `INVALID_QUERY` | Paramètre de requête invalide |\r\n| 400 | `INVALID_BODY` | Corps de requête invalide |\r\n| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED` | Session absente, expirée ou invalide ; compte non autorisé à se connecter |\r\n| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Utilisateur connecté, mais sans droit sur la ressource |\r\n| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | Route inconnue |\r\n| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Erreur inattendue du serveur |\r\n\r\n## GET /health\r\n\r\nIndique que l'API répond.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : `{ \"status\": \"ok\" }`\r\n\r\n## GET /auth/demo-users\r\n\r\n*Mode démo uniquement.* Liste les utilisateurs qui peuvent se connecter : comptes actifs,\r\net contacts ayant au moins un rôle.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'utilisateurs (même format que `GET /auth/me`)\r\n- `404` : mode démo désactivé\r\n\r\n## POST /auth/demo-login\r\n\r\n*Mode démo uniquement.* Ouvre une session sous l'identité choisie, sans mot de passe.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Body JSON : `{ \"kind\": \"ADMIN\" | \"STUDENT\" | \"CONTACT\", \"id\": 4 }`\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : `{ \"token\": \"…\", \"user\": { … } }`\r\n- `400` `INVALID_BODY` : `kind` inconnu ou `id` qui n'est pas un entier positif\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : utilisateur inexistant, inactif, à vérifier, ou contact sans rôle\r\n- `404` : mode démo désactivé\r\n\r\n## GET /auth/me\r\n\r\nRetourne l'utilisateur connecté.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` :\r\n\r\n```json\r\n{\r\n  \"kind\": \"CONTACT\",\r\n  \"id\": 4,\r\n  \"firstName\": \"Julien\",\r\n  \"lastName\": \"Lambert\",\r\n  \"email\": \"julien.lambert@lumen.test\",\r\n  \"roles\": [\"DEPOSITOR\", \"PROMOTER\", \"SIGNATORY\"],\r\n  \"companies\": [\r\n    { \"id\": 3, \"shortName\": \"Lumen Data\" },\r\n    { \"id\": 2, \"shortName\": \"Lumen Digital\" }\r\n  ]\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n`roles` et `companies` sont vides pour un administrateur ou un étudiant.\r\n\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : jeton absent, invalide ou expiré, ou compte désactivé\r\n\r\n## GET /companies\r\n\r\nListe les entreprises, triées par nom complet. Un administrateur voit toutes les\r\nentreprises ; les autres utilisateurs ne voient que les entreprises actives.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Paramètre facultatif `q` : texte cherché dans le nom complet et le nom abrégé, sans tenir\r\n  compte de la casse. Une valeur vide est ignorée. 100 caractères au maximum.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'entreprises\r\n\r\n```json\r\n[\r\n  {\r\n    \"id\": 2,\r\n    \"name\": \"Lumen Digital SRL\",\r\n    \"shortName\": \"Lumen Digital\",\r\n    \"locality\": \"Louvain-la-Neuve\",\r\n    \"status\": \"ACTIVE\"\r\n  }\r\n]\r\n```\r\n\r\n`status` vaut `ACTIVE`, `TO_VERIFY` (fiche à vérifier) ou `ARCHIVED`.\r\n\r\n- `400` `INVALID_QUERY` : `q` est répété ou dépasse 100 caractères.\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide.\r\n\r\n## GET /offers\r\n\r\nListe les offres visibles par l'utilisateur connecté, de l'année académique la plus\r\nrécente à la plus ancienne, puis de la plus récente à la plus ancienne.\r\n\r\n| Profil | Offres retournées |\r\n|---|---|\r\n| Administrateur | Toutes |\r\n| Étudiant | Les offres publiées |\r\n| Contact déposant | Les offres qu'il a déposées, quel que soit leur statut |\r\n| Contact sans rôle de déposant | Aucun accès (403) |\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Paramètre facultatif `period` : `P1`, `P2` ou `Autre`. En son absence, toutes les\r\n  périodes visibles pour le profil sont retournées.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'offres\r\n\r\n```json\r\n[\r\n  {\r\n    \"id\": 3,\r\n    \"title\": \"API REST de facturation\",\r\n    \"companyShortName\": \"Orbis\",\r\n    \"academicYear\": \"2026-2027\",\r\n    \"period\": \"P2\",\r\n    \"status\": \"PUBLISHED\"\r\n  }\r\n]\r\n```\r\n\r\n`period` vaut `P1`, `P2` ou `OTHER`. `status` vaut `SUBMITTED` (soumise), `PENDING`\r\n(en attente), `PUBLISHED` (publiée), `ASSIGNED` (attribuée) ou `ARCHIVED` (archivée).\r\n\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide.\r\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : contact seulement promoteur ou signataire.\r\n- `400` `INVALID_QUERY` : paramètre `period` répété ou différent de `P1`, `P2` et `Autre`.\r\n\r\n## POST /applications\r\n\r\nUn étudiant candidate à une offre publiée. L'étudiant est déterminé par la session, jamais\r\npar une valeur du corps de la requête. Le message est facultatif; les espaces extérieurs\r\nsont supprimés, une valeur vide devient `null`, et le texte normalisé ne peut pas dépasser\r\n1000 caractères.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Body JSON : `{ \"offerId\": 5, \"message\": \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\" }`\r\n- `message` peut être omis ou être une chaîne vide.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `201` : candidature créée\r\n\r\n```json\r\n{\r\n  \"id\": 7,\r\n  \"offerId\": 5,\r\n  \"message\": \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\",\r\n  \"status\": \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n  \"appliedAt\": \"2026-11-09 12:00:00\"\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n- `400` `INVALID_BODY` : corps invalide ou message de plus de 1000 caractères\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide\r\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : utilisateur connecté qui n'est pas étudiant\r\n- `404` `NOT_FOUND` : offre inexistante\r\n- `409` `OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED` : offre existante dont le statut n'est pas `PUBLISHED`\r\n- `409` `APPLICATION_EXISTS` : candidature déjà présente pour cet étudiant et cette offre\r\n  avec un statut différent de `WITHDRAWN`\r\n\n## GET /applications/me\n\nRetourne toutes les candidatures de l'étudiant connecté, y compris celles retirées, de la\nplus récente à la plus ancienne. Les données sont filtrées à partir de la session; aucun\nidentifiant étudiant n'est accepté dans l'URL ou les paramètres.\n\n### Requête\n\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\n- Aucun paramètre\n\n### Réponses\n\n- `200` : tableau de candidatures\n\n```json\n[\n  {\n    \"id\": 1,\n    \"offerId\": 1,\n    \"offerTitle\": \"Application React de gestion de flotte\",\n    \"companyShortName\": \"Lumen Digital\",\n    \"academicYear\": \"2026-2027\",\n    \"period\": \"P2\",\n    \"message\": \"Le développement React m'intéresse particulièrement.\",\n    \"status\": \"IN_PROGRESS\",\n    \"appliedAt\": \"2026-10-02 18:10:00\"\n  }\n]\n```\n\n`status` vaut `IN_PROGRESS`, `SELECTED`, `REJECTED` ou `WITHDRAWN`. `period` vaut `P1`,\n`P2` ou `OTHER`. Cette étape retourne les candidatures de toutes les années; le filtre\npar défaut sur l'année en cours (EF-72) reste à implémenter.\n\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : utilisateur connecté qui n'est pas étudiant\n",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 248,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }

                "text": "### Connexion de démo : étudiant Lucas\r\n# @name student\r\nPOST http://localhost:3000/auth/demo-login\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n{ \"kind\": \"STUDENT\", \"id\": 1 }\r\n\r\n### Connexion de démo : étudiant Dmytro (utilisé pour candidater sans message)\r\n# @name studentWithoutMessage\r\nPOST http://localhost:3000/auth/demo-login\r\nContent-Type: application/json\r\n\r\n{ \"kind\": \"STUDENT\", \"id\": 8 }\r\n\r\n### Connexion de démo : administratrice\r\n# @name admin\r\nPOST http://localhost:3000/auth/demo-login\r\nContent-Type:               {
                "text": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\nimport type { ApplicationListItem } from \"../models/application.ts\";\nimport { getMyApplications } from \"../services/applications-list.service.ts\";\nimport { isUnauthorized } from \"../utils/api.ts\";\n\nexport const useApplications = (token: string, onUnauthorized: () => void) => {\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState<ApplicationListItem[]>([]);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    const controller = new AbortController();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    getMyApplications(token, controller.signal)\n      .then((data) => {\n        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setApplications(data);\n      })\n      .catch((reason: unknown) => {\n        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;\n        if (isUnauthorized(reason)) {\n          onUnauthorized();\n        } else {\n          setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : \"Erreur inconnue\");\n        }\n      })\n      .finally(() => {\n        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setIsLoading(false);\n      });\n\n    return () => controller.abort();\n  }, [token, onUnauthorized]);\n\n  return { applications, isLoading, error };\n};",

PENDING: \"En attente\",\n  PUBLISHED: \"Publiée\",\n  ASSIGNED: \"Attribuée\",\n  ARCHIVED: \"Archivée\",\n};\n\nexport const OFFER_STATUS_TONES: Record<OfferStatus, StatusTone> = {\n  SUBMITTED: from \"./components/LoadingState.tsx\";\nimport { useAuth } from \"./hooks/useAuth.ts\";\nimport CompaniesPage from \"./pages/CompaniesPage.tsx\";\nimport ApplicationsPage from \"./pages/ApplicationsPage.tsx\";\nimport HomePage from \"./pages/HomePage.tsx\";\nimport LoginPage from \"./pages/LoginPage.tsx\";\nimport NotFoundPage from \"./pages/NotFoundPage.tsx\";\nimport OffersPage from \"./pages/OffersPage.tsx\";\nimport { canListApplications, canListOffers } from \"./utils/permissions.ts\";\n\nconst App = () => {\n  const auth = useAuth();\n\n  const renderContent = () => {\n    if (auth.error) return <ErrorState message={auth.error} />;\n    if (auth.isLoading) return <LoadingState message=\"Vérification de la session…\" />;\n    if (auth.user === null || auth.token === null) return <LoginPage onLogin={auth.login} />;\n\n    return (\n      <Routes>\n        <Route path=\"/\" element={<HomePage user={auth.user} />} />\n        {canListOffers(auth.user) && (\n          <Route\n            path=\"/offres\"\n            element={\n              <OffersPage user={auth.user} token={auth.token} onUnauthorized={auth.logout} />\n            }\n          />\n        )}\n        {canListApplications(auth.user) && (\n          <Route\n            path=\"/mes-candidatures\"\n            element={\n              <ApplicationsPage token={auth.token} onUnauthorized={auth.logout} />\n            }\n          />\n        )}\n        <Route\n          path=\"/entreprises\"\n          element={<CompaniesPage token={auth.token} onUnauthorized={auth.logout} />}\n        />\n        <Route path=\"*\" element={<NotFoundPage />} />\n      </Routes>\n    );\n  };\n\n  return (\n    <Layout user={auth.user} onLogout={auth.logout}>\n      {renderContent()}\n    </Layout>\n  );\n};\n\nexport default App;\n",

          "edits": [

              {
                "text": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\r\nimport type { ApplicationListItem } from \"../models/application.ts\";\r\nimport { getMyApplications } from \"../services/applications.service.ts\";\nimport { isUnauthorized } from \"../utils/api.ts\";\r\n\r\nexport const useApplications = (token: string, onUnauthorized: () => void) => {\r\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState<ApplicationListItem[]>([]);\r\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\r\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\r\n\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    const controller = new AbortController();\r\n    setIsLoading(true);\r\n    setError(null);\r\n\r\n    getMyApplications(token, controller.signal)\r\n      .then((data) => {\r\n        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setApplications(data);\r\n      })\r\n      .catch((reason: unknown) => {\r\n        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;\r\n        if (isUnauthorized(reason)) {\r\n          onUnauthorized();\r\n        } else {\r\n          setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : \"Erreur inconnue\");\r\n        }\r\n      })\r\n      .finally(() => {\r\n        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setIsLoading(false);\r\n      });\r\n\r\n    return () => controller.abort();\r\n  }, [token, onUnauthorized]);\r\n\r\n  return { applications, isLoading, error };\r\n};",

                "text": "import { render, screen } from \"@testing-library/react\";\nimport { MemoryRouter } from \"react-router\";\nimport { describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\nimport NavBar from \"../src/components/NavBar.tsx\";\nimport type { User } from \"../src/models/user.ts\";\nimport { adminUser, contactUser, promoterUser, studentUser } from \"./helpers/fetchMock.ts\";\n\nconst renderNavBar = (user: User) =>\n  render(\n    <MemoryRouter>\n      <NavBar user={user} />\n    </MemoryRouter>,\n  );\n\ndescribe(\"NavBar\", () => {\n  it.each([\n    [\"un administrateur\", adminUser],\n    [\"un étudiant\", studentUser],\n    [\"un déposant\", contactUser],\n  ])(\"propose les offres à %s\", (_profile, user) => {\n    renderNavBar(user);\n\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Offres\" })).toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Entreprises\" })).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it(\"propose Mes candidatures uniquement à l'étudiant\", () => {\n    const { unmount } = renderNavBar(studentUser);\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Mes candidatures\" })).toHaveAttribute(\n      \"href\",\n      \"/mes-candidatures\",\n    );\n    unmount();\n\n    renderNavBar(adminUser);\n    expect(screen.queryByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Mes candidatures\" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it(\"ne propose pas les offres à un contact sans rôle de déposant\", () => {\n    renderNavBar(promoterUser);\n\n    expect(screen.queryByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Offres\" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Entreprises\" })).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n});\n",

expect(isHealth({ status: \"ok\" })).toBe(true);\n  });\n\n  it.each([null, \"ok\", {}, { status: \"ko\" }])(\"refuse %j\", (value) => {\n    expect(isHealth(value)).toBe(false);\n  });\n});\n\nconst \"../models/user.ts\";\r\n\r\nconst isRecord = (value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> =>\r\n  typeof value === \"object\" && value !== null;\r\n\r\nconst isOneOf = <T extends string>(values: readonly T[], value: unknown): value is T =>\r\n  typeof value === \"string\" && (values as readonly string[]).includes(value);\r\n\r\nexport const isPeriodCode = (value: unknown): value is PeriodCode =>\r\n  isOneOf(PERIOD_CODES, value);\r\n\r\nexport const isHealth = (value: unknown): value is Health =>\r\n  isRecord(value) && value.status === \"ok\";\r\n\r\nconst typeof value.id === \"number\" &&\r\n  typeof value.name === \"string\" &&\r\n  typeof value.shortName === \"string\" &&\r\n  typeof value.locality === \"string\" &&\r\n  isCompanyStatus(value.status);\r\n\r\nexport const isCompanyList = (value: unknown): value is Company[] =>\r\n  Array.isArray(value) && value.every(isCompany);\r\n\r\nconst isCompanySummary = (value: value.companies.every(isCompanySummary);\r\n\r\nexport const isUserList = (value: unknown): value is User[] =>\r\n  Array.isArray(value) && value.every(isUser);\r\n\r\nexport const isSession = (value:                 "text": "import { render, screen } from \"@testing-library/react\";\nimport { MemoryRouter } from \"react-router\";\nimport { describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\nimport NavBar from \"../src/components/NavBar.tsx\";\nimport type { User } from \"../src/models/user.ts\";\nimport { adminUser, contactUser, promoterUser, studentUser } from \"./helpers/fetchMock.ts\";\n\nconst renderNavBar = (user: User) =>\n  render(\n    <MemoryRouter>\n      <NavBar user={user} />\n    </MemoryRouter>,\n  );\n\ndescribe(\"NavBar\", () => {\n  it.each([\n    [\"un administrateur\", adminUser],\n    [\"un étudiant\", studentUser],\n    [\"un déposant\", contactUser],\n  ])(\"propose les offres à %s\", (_profile, user) => {\n    renderNavBar(user);\n\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Offres\" })).toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Entreprises\" })).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it(\"propose Mes candidatures à l'étudiant\", () => {\n    const { unmount } = renderNavBar(studentUser);\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Mes candidatures\" })).toHaveAttribute(\n      \"href\",\n      \"/mes-candidatures\",\n    );\n    unmount();\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [\"administrateur\", adminUser],\n    [\"contact déposant\", contactUser],\n  ])(\"masque Mes candidatures à un %s\", (_profile, user) => {\n    renderNavBar(user);\n\n    expect(screen.queryByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Mes candidatures\" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n\n  it(\"ne propose pas les offres à un contact sans rôle de déposant\", () => {\n    renderNavBar(promoterUser);\n\n    expect(screen.queryByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Offres\" })).not.toBeInTheDocument();\n    expect(screen.getByRole(\"link\", { name: \"Entreprises\" })).toBeInTheDocument();\n  });\n});\n",
                "range": {

              {
                "text": "import type { Db } from \"../db/database.ts\";\r\nimport type { ApplicationDbo, ApplicationListDbo } from \"../models/application.ts\";\r\nimport type { OfferStatus } from \"../models/offer.ts\";\r\n\r\ninterface OfferStatusRow {\r\n  status: OfferStatus;\r\n}\r\n\r\ninterface ApplicationParams {\r\n  offerId: number;\r\n  studentId: number;\r\n  message: string | null;\r\n}\r\n\r\nexport const createApplicationsRepository = (db: Db) => {\r\n  const findOfferStatus = db.prepare<{ offerId: number }, OfferStatusRow>(\r\n    \"SELECT status FROM offers WHERE id = @offerId\",\r\n  );\r\n  const findActive = db.prepare<{ offerId: number; studentId: number }, { id: number }>(`\r\n    SELECT id FROM applications\r\n    WHERE offer_id = @offerId AND student_id = @studentId AND status <> 'WITHDRAWN'\r\n    LIMIT 1\r\n  `);\r\n  const insertApplication = db.prepare<ApplicationParams>(`\r\n    INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id, message)\r\n    VALUES (@offerId, @studentId, @message)\r\n  `);\r\n  const findById = db.prepare<{ id: number }, ApplicationDbo>(`\r\n    SELECT id, offer_id, student_id, message, status, applied_at\r\n    FROM applications WHERE id = @id\r\n  `);\r\n  const findByIdForStudent = db.prepare<\n    { id: number; studentId: number },\n    ApplicationDbo\n  >(`\n    SELECT id, offer_id, student_id, message, status, applied_at\n    FROM applications\n    WHERE id = @id AND student_id = @studentId\n  `);\n  const withdrawInProgress = db.prepare<{ id: number; studentId: number }>(`\n    UPDATE applications SET status = 'WITHDRAWN'\n    WHERE id = @id AND student_id = @studentId AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'\n  `);\n  const findByStudentId = db.prepare<{ studentId: number }, ApplicationListDbo>(`\r\n    SELECT a.id, a.offer_id, a.student_id, a.message, a.status, a.applied_at,\r\n           o.title AS offer_title, c.short_name AS company_short_name,\r\n           ay.label AS academic_year_label, p.code AS period_code\r\n    FROM applications a\r\n    JOIN offers o ON o.id = a.offer_id\r\n    JOIN companies c ON c.id = o.company_id\r\n    JOIN academic_years ay ON ay.id = o.academic_year_id\r\n    JOIN periods p ON p.id = o.period_id\r\n    WHERE a.student_id = @studentId\r\n    ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC, a.id DESC\r\n  `);\r\n\r\n  return {\r\n    findOfferStatus: (offerId: number): OfferStatus | undefined =>\r\n      findOfferStatus.get({ offerId })?.status,\r\n    hasActiveForOffer: (offerId: number, studentId: number): boolean =>\r\n      findActive.get({ offerId, studentId }) !== undefined,\r\n    findAllForStudent: (studentId: number): ApplicationListDbo[] =>\r\n      findByStudentId.all({ studentId }),\r\n    findByIdForStudent: (id: number, studentId: number): ApplicationDbo | undefined =>\n      findByIdForStudent.get({ id, studentId }),\n    withdrawIfInProgress: (id: number, studentId: number): boolean =>\n      withdrawInProgress.run({ id, studentId }).changes === 1,\n    create: (params: ApplicationParams): ApplicationDbo => {\r\n      const result = insertApplication.run(params);\r\n      const application = findById.get({ id: Number(result.lastInsertRowid) });\r\n      if (application === undefined) throw new Error(\"Candidature créée introuvable\");\r\n      return application;\r\n    },\r\n  };\r\n};\r\n\r\nexport type ApplicationsRepository = ReturnType<typeof createApplicationsRepository>;",

                "text": "import type { ContactRole, User } from \"../models/user.ts\";\n\n// Règles d'accès du CdC (§ 4), indépendantes d'Express. Les contrôleurs les appliquent\n// avec le middleware authorize ; les services s'en servent pour filtrer les données.\n\nexport const isAdmin = (user: User): boolean => user.kind === \"ADMIN\";\n\nexport const isStudent = (user: User): boolean => user.kind === \"STUDENT\";\n\nexport const canApplyToOffers = (user: User): boolean => isStudent(user);\n\nexport const canViewOwnApplications = (user: User): boolean => isStudent(user);\n\nexport const canWithdrawOwnApplications = (user: User): boolean => isStudent(user);\n\n/** Les rôles d'un contact s'exercent dans toutes ses entreprises. */\nexport const hasContactRole = (user: User, role: ContactRole): boolean =>\n  user.kind === \"CONTACT\" && user.roles.includes(role);\n\n/**\n * Consulter des offres : l'administrateur, l'étudiant et le déposant. Un contact\n * seulement promoteur ou signataire n'y a pas accès.\n */\nexport const canListOffers = (user: User): boolean =>\n  isAdmin(user) || isStudent(user) || hasContactRole(user, \"DEPOSITOR\");\n",

                "text": "import { toApplication, toApplicationListItem } from \"../mappers/application.mapper.ts\";\r\nimport type { Application, ApplicationListItem } from \"../models/application.ts\";\r\nimport type { User } from \"../models/user.ts\";\r\nimport type { ApplicationsRepository } from \"../repositories/applications.repository.ts\";\r\nimport { HttpError } from \"../utils/httpError.ts\";\r\nimport {\n  canApplyToOffers,\n  canViewOwnApplications,\n  canWithdrawOwnApplications,\n} from \"./permissions.ts\";\n\r\nconst MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH = 1000;\r\n\r\nconst isUniqueConstraintError = (error: unknown): boolean =>\r\n  typeof error === \"object\" &&\r\n  error !== null &&\r\n  \"code\" in error &&\r\n  error.code === \"SQLITE_CONSTRAINT_UNIQUE\";\r\n\r\nexport const createApplicationsService = (repository: ApplicationsRepository) => ({\r\n  listOwnApplications: (student: User): ApplicationListItem[] => {\r\n    if (!canViewOwnApplications(student)) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(403, \"FORBIDDEN\", \"Seul un étudiant peut consulter ses candidatures\");\r\n    }\r\n    return repository.findAllForStudent(student.id).map(toApplicationListItem);\r\n  },\r\n\n  withdrawApplication: (student: User, applicationId: number): Application => {\n    if (!canWithdrawOwnApplications(student)) {\n      throw new HttpError(403, \"FORBIDDEN\", \"Seul un étudiant peut retirer sa candidature\");\n    }\n\n    const application = repository.findByIdForStudent(applicationId, student.id);\n    if (application === undefined) {\n      throw new HttpError(404, \"NOT_FOUND\", \"Candidature introuvable\");\n    }\n    if (application.status !== \"IN_PROGRESS\") {\n      throw new HttpError(\n        409,\n        \"APPLICATION_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE\",\n        \"Cette candidature ne peut plus être retirée\",\n      );\n    }\n    if (!repository.withdrawIfInProgress(applicationId, student.id)) {\n      const currentApplication = repository.findByIdForStudent(applicationId, student.id);\n      if (currentApplication === undefined) {\n        throw new HttpError(404, \"NOT_FOUND\", \"Candidature introuvable\");\n      }\n      throw new HttpError(\n        409,\n        \"APPLICATION_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE\",\n        \"Cette candidature ne peut plus être retirée\",\n      );\n    }\n\n    return toApplication({ ...application, status: \"WITHDRAWN\" });\n  },\n\r\n  applyToOffer: (student: User, offerId: number, message?: string): Application => {\r\n    if (!canApplyToOffers(student)) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(403, \"FORBIDDEN\", \"Seul un étudiant peut candidater\");\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const offerStatus = repository.findOfferStatus(offerId);\r\n    if (offerStatus === undefined) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(404, \"NOT_FOUND\", \"Offre introuvable\");\r\n    }\r\n    if (offerStatus !== \"PUBLISHED\") {\r\n      throw new HttpError(409, \"OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED\", \"Cette offre n'est pas publiée\");\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const normalizedMessage = message?.trim() || null;\r\n    if (normalizedMessage !== null && normalizedMessage.length > MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(\r\n        400,\r\n        \"INVALID_BODY\",\r\n        `Le message ne peut pas dépasser ${MAX_MESSAGE_LENGTH} caractères`,\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    if (repository.hasActiveForOffer(offerId, student.id)) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(409, \"APPLICATION_EXISTS\", \"Vous avez déjà candidaté à cette offre\");\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    try {\r\n      return toApplication(\r\n        repository.create({ offerId, studentId: student.id, message: normalizedMessage }),\r\n      );\r\n    } catch (error) {\r\n      if (isUniqueConstraintError(error)) {\r\n        throw new HttpError(409, \"APPLICATION_EXISTS\", \"Vous avez déjà candidaté à cette offre\");\r\n      }\r\n      throw error;\r\n    }\r\n  },\r\n});\r\n\r\nexport type ApplicationsService = ReturnType<typeof createApplicationsService>;",

router.post(\"/\", authorize(canApplyToOffers), (req, res) => {\r\n    const body: unknown = req.body;\r\n    if (!isCreateApplicationBody(body)) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(\r\n        400,\r\n        \"INVALID_BODY\",\r\n        \"Le corps doit contenir offerId (entier positif) et un message facultatif\",\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const application = applicationsService.applyToOffer(\r\n      getCurrentUser(req),\r\n      body.offerId,\r\n      body.message,\r\n    );\r\n    res.status(201).json(toApplicationDto(application));\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  return router;\r\n};",

                "text": "import request from \"supertest\";\r\nimport { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\r\nimport { ADMINISTRATOR, APPLICATION, CONTACT, OFFER, STUDENT } from \"../src/db/seed/seedIds.ts\";\r\nimport type { Db } from \"../src/db/database.ts\";\r\nimport { createTestApp, tokenFor } from \"./helpers/testApp.ts\";\r\nimport { createTestDatabase } from \"./helpers/testDatabase.ts\";\r\n\r\nlet db: Db;\r\nlet app: ReturnType<typeof createTestApp>;\r\n\r\nbeforeEach(() => {\r\n  db = createTestDatabase();\r\n  app = createTestApp(db);\r\n});\r\n\r\nconst applyAs = (kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\", id: number, body: object) =>\r\n  request(app)\r\n    .post(\"/applications\")\r\n    .set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, id))\r\n    .send(body);\r\n\r\nconst listAs = (kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\", id: number) =>\r\n  request(app).get(\"/applications/me\").set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, id));\r\n\nconst withdrawAs = (\n  kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\",\n  userId: number,\n  applicationId: number,\n) =>\n  request(app)\n    .patch(`/applications/${applicationId}/withdraw`)\n    .set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, userId));\n\r\ndescribe(\"GET /applications/me : accès et isolation\", () => {\r\n  it(\"refuse une requête sans session (401)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await request(app).get(\"/applications/me\");\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(401);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\r\n    [\"administrateur\", \"ADMIN\" as const, ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ],\r\n    [\"contact déposant\", \"CONTACT\" as const, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE],\r\n  ])(\"refuse la consultation par un %s (403)\", async (_profile, kind, id) => {\r\n    const response = await listAs(kind, id);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"retourne uniquement les candidatures de l'étudiant connecté\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await listAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\r\n    expect(response.body.map((application: { id: number }) => application.id)).toEqual([\r\n      APPLICATION.INES_FLEET_APP,\r\n      APPLICATION.INES_BILLING_API,\r\n    ]);\r\n    expect(response.body.every((application: { offerTitle: string }) =>\r\n      typeof application.offerTitle === \"string\",\r\n    )).toBe(true);\r\n    expect(response.body[0]).toMatchObject({\r\n      offerId: OFFER.FLEET_APP,\r\n      offerTitle: \"Application React de gestion de flotte\",\r\n      companyShortName: \"Lumen Digital\",\r\n      academicYear: \"2026-2027\",\r\n      period: \"P2\",\r\n      status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n    });\r\n    expect(response.body[0]).not.toHaveProperty(\"studentId\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"ne révèle pas les candidatures d'un autre étudiant\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await listAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.YOUSSEF_EL_AMRANI);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveLength(1);\r\n    expect(response.body[0].id).toBe(APPLICATION.YOUSSEF_BILLING_API);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"retourne une liste vide pour un étudiant sans candidature\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await listAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\r\n    expect(response.body).toEqual([]);\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : accès\", () => {\r\n  it(\"refuse une requête sans session (401)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await request(app).post(\"/applications\").send({ offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(401);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\r\n    [\"administrateur\", \"ADMIN\" as const, ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ],\r\n    [\"contact déposant\", \"CONTACT\" as const, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE],\r\n  ])(\"refuse une candidature par %s (403)\", async (_profile, kind, id) => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(kind, id, { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : création\", () => {\r\n  it(\"crée une candidature avec un message normalisé\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"  Le sujet m'intéresse.  \",\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\",\r\n      status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n    });\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"id\");\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"appliedAt\");\r\n    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty(\"studentId\");\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\r\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([undefined, \"\", \"   \"])(\"accepte un message vide (%s) et le stocke à NULL\", async (message) => {\r\n    const body = { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, ...(message === undefined ? {} : { message }) };\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, body);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.message).toBeNull();\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT message FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { message: string | null };\r\n    expect(stored.message).toBeNull();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"accepte un message normalisé de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: ` ${\"x\".repeat(1000)} `,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.message).toHaveLength(1000);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"rejette un message normalisé de plus de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"x\".repeat(1001),\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"dérive l'étudiant de la session et ignore tout studentId fourni\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      studentId: STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\r\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : refus\", () => {\r\n  it(\"rejette un corps invalide\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: 0,\r\n      message: 12,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"renvoie 404 pour une offre inexistante\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, { offerId: 999 });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(404);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"NOT_FOUND\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"refuse une offre existante qui n'est pas publiée (409)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.CLIENT_PORTAL,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(409);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\"IN_PROGRESS\", \"SELECTED\", \"REJECTED\"] as const)(\r\n    \"refuse une candidature déjà existante au statut %s\",\r\n    async (status) => {\r\n      if (status !== \"IN_PROGRESS\") {\r\n        db.prepare(\r\n          \"INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\r\n        ).run(OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, status);\r\n      }\r\n      const offerId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? OFFER.FLEET_APP : OFFER.DATA_QUALITY;\r\n      const studentId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT : STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO;\r\n\r\n      const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", studentId, { offerId });\r\n\r\n      expect(response.status).toBe(409);\r\n      expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"APPLICATION_EXISTS\");\r\n    },\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  it(\"permet de candidater à nouveau après une candidature retirée\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD, { offerId: OFFER.BILLING_API });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.status).toBe(\"IN_PROGRESS\");\r\n  });\r\n});",

                "text": "import request from \"supertest\";\r\nimport { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from \"vitest\";\r\nimport { ADMINISTRATOR, APPLICATION, CONTACT, OFFER, STUDENT } from \"../src/db/seed/seedIds.ts\";\r\nimport type { Db } from \"../src/db/database.ts\";\r\nimport { createTestApp, tokenFor } from \"./helpers/testApp.ts\";\r\nimport { createTestDatabase } from \"./helpers/testDatabase.ts\";\r\n\r\nlet db: Db;\r\nlet app: ReturnType<typeof createTestApp>;\r\n\r\nbeforeEach(() => {\r\n  db = createTestDatabase();\r\n  app = createTestApp(db);\r\n});\r\n\r\nconst applyAs = (kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\", id: number, body: object) =>\r\n  request(app)\r\n    .post(\"/applications\")\r\n    .set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, id))\r\n    .send(body);\r\n\r\nconst listAs = (kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\", id: number) =>\r\n  request(app).get(\"/applications/me\").set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, id));\r\n\r\nconst withdrawAs = (\r\n  kind: \"STUDENT\" | \"ADMIN\" | \"CONTACT\",\r\n  userId: number,\r\n  applicationId: number,\r\n) =>\r\n  request(app)\r\n    .patch(`/applications/${applicationId}/withdraw`)\r\n    .set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(kind, userId));\r\n\ndescribe(\"PATCH /applications/:applicationId/withdraw\", () => {\n  it(\"retire une candidature en cours en conservant son historique\", async () => {\n    const response = await withdrawAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT, APPLICATION.LUCAS_FLEET_APP);\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\n    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({\n      id: APPLICATION.LUCAS_FLEET_APP,\n      offerId: OFFER.FLEET_APP,\n      message: \"Le développement React m'intéresse particulièrement.\",\n      status: \"WITHDRAWN\",\n    });\n    const stored = db\n      .prepare(\"SELECT id, student_id, message, status FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\n      .get(APPLICATION.LUCAS_FLEET_APP) as {\n      id: number;\n      student_id: number;\n      message: string;\n      status: string;\n    };\n    expect(stored).toEqual({\n      id: APPLICATION.LUCAS_FLEET_APP,\n      student_id: STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT,\n      message: \"Le développement React m'intéresse particulièrement.\",\n      status: \"WITHDRAWN\",\n    });\n\n    const reapplication = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT, {\n      offerId: OFFER.FLEET_APP,\n    });\n    expect(reapplication.status).toBe(201);\n  });\n\n  it.each([\n    [\"retenue\", STUDENT.MATEUSZ_KOWALSKI, APPLICATION.MATEUSZ_CLOUD_MIGRATION],\n    [\"non retenue\", STUDENT.LEA_MERTENS, APPLICATION.LEA_CLOUD_MIGRATION],\n    [\"déjà retirée\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD, APPLICATION.INES_BILLING_API],\n  ] as const)(\"refuse le retrait d'une candidature %s (409)\", async (_status, studentId, applicationId) => {\n    const response = await withdrawAs(\"STUDENT\", studentId, applicationId);\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(409);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"APPLICATION_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"renvoie 404 si la candidature appartient à un autre étudiant\", async () => {\n    const response = await withdrawAs(\n      \"STUDENT\",\n      STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT,\n      APPLICATION.INES_FLEET_APP,\n    );\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(404);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"NOT_FOUND\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"renvoie 404 si la candidature n'existe pas\", async () => {\n    const response = await withdrawAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT, 999);\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(404);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"NOT_FOUND\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"refuse le retrait par un administrateur (403)\", async () => {\n    const response = await withdrawAs(\n      \"ADMIN\",\n      ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ,\n      APPLICATION.LUCAS_FLEET_APP,\n    );\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\n  });\n\n  it(\"rejette un identifiant invalide (400)\", async () => {\n    const response = await request(app)\n      .patch(\"/applications/0/withdraw\")\n      .set(\"Authorization\", tokenFor(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT));\n\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_QUERY\");\n  });\n});\n\r\ndescribe(\"GET /applications/me : accès et isolation\", () => {\r\n  it(\"refuse une requête sans session (401)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await request(app).get(\"/applications/me\");\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(401);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\r\n    [\"administrateur\", \"ADMIN\" as const, ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ],\r\n    [\"contact déposant\", \"CONTACT\" as const, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE],\r\n  ])(\"refuse la consultation par un %s (403)\", async (_profile, kind, id) => {\r\n    const response = await listAs(kind, id);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"retourne uniquement les candidatures de l'étudiant connecté\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await listAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\r\n    expect(response.body.map((application: { id: number }) => application.id)).toEqual([\r\n      APPLICATION.INES_FLEET_APP,\r\n      APPLICATION.INES_BILLING_API,\r\n    ]);\r\n    expect(response.body.every((application: { offerTitle: string }) =>\r\n      typeof application.offerTitle === \"string\",\r\n    )).toBe(true);\r\n    expect(response.body[0]).toMatchObject({\r\n      offerId: OFFER.FLEET_APP,\r\n      offerTitle: \"Application React de gestion de flotte\",\r\n      companyShortName: \"Lumen Digital\",\r\n expect(response.body).toHaveLength(1);\r\n    expect(response.body[0].id).toBe(APPLICATION.YOUSSEF_BILLING_API);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"retourne une liste vide pour un étudiant sans candidature\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await listAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO);\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(200);\r\n    expect(response.body).toEqual([]);\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : accès\", () => {\r\n  it(\"refuse une requête sans session (401)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await request(app).post(\"/applications\").send({ offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(401);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\r\n    [\"administrateur\", \"ADMIN\" as const, ADMINISTRATOR.ANNE_LECLERCQ],\r\n    [\"contact déposant\", \"CONTACT\" as const, CONTACT.MARC_LEJEUNE],\r\n  ])(\"refuse une candidature par %s (403)\", async (_profile, kind, id) => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(kind, id, { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(403);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"FORBIDDEN\");\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : création\", () => {\r\n  it(\"crée une candidature avec un message normalisé\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"  Le sujet m'intéresse.  \",\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body).toMatchObject({\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\",\r\n      status: \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n    });\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"id\");\r\n    expect(response.body).toHaveProperty(\"appliedAt\");\r\n    expect(response.body).not.toHaveProperty(\"studentId\");\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\r\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([undefined, \"\", \"   \"])(\"accepte un message vide (%s) et le stocke à NULL\", async (message) => {\r\n    const body = { offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, ...(message === undefined expect(response.body.message).toBeNull();\r\n    const stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT message FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { message: string | null };\r\n    expect(stored.message).toBeNull();\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"accepte un message normalisé de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", expect(response.body.message).toHaveLength(1000);\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"rejette un message normalisé de plus de 1000 caractères\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.DATA_QUALITY,\r\n      message: \"x\".repeat(1001),\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"dérive l'étudiant de la session et ignore tout studentId fourni\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await stored = db\r\n      .prepare(\"SELECT student_id FROM applications WHERE id = ?\")\r\n      .get(response.body.id) as { student_id: number };\r\n    expect(stored.student_id).toBe(STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES);\r\n  });\r\n});\r\n\r\ndescribe(\"POST /applications : refus\", () => {\r\n  it(\"rejette un corps invalide\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: 0,\r\n      message: 12,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(400);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"INVALID_BODY\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"renvoie 404 pour une offre inexistante\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, { offerId: 999 });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(404);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"NOT_FOUND\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it(\"refuse une offre existante qui n'est pas publiée (409)\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.LOUIS_CLAES, {\r\n      offerId: OFFER.CLIENT_PORTAL,\r\n    });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(409);\r\n    expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED\");\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  it.each([\"IN_PROGRESS\", \"SELECTED\", \"REJECTED\"] as const)(\r\n    \"refuse une candidature déjà existante au statut %s\",\r\n    async (status) => {\r\n      if (status !== \"IN_PROGRESS\") {\r\n        db.prepare(\r\n          \"INSERT INTO applications (offer_id, student_id, status) VALUES (?, ?, ?)\",\r\n        ).run(OFFER.DATA_QUALITY, STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO, status);\r\n      }\r\n      const offerId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? OFFER.FLEET_APP : OFFER.DATA_QUALITY;\r\n      const studentId = status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" ? STUDENT.LUCAS_DUPONT : STUDENT.DMYTRO_KOVALENKO;\r\n\r\n      const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", studentId, { offerId });\r\n\r\n      expect(response.status).toBe(409);\r\n      expect(response.body.error.code).toBe(\"APPLICATION_EXISTS\");\r\n    },\r\n  );\r\n\r\n  it(\"permet de candidater à nouveau après une candidature retirée\", async () => {\r\n    const response = await applyAs(\"STUDENT\", STUDENT.INES_HADDAD, { offerId: OFFER.BILLING_API });\r\n\r\n    expect(response.status).toBe(201);\r\n    expect(response.body.status).toBe(\"IN_PROGRESS\");\r\n  });\r\n});",

                "text": "# API Gesta\r\n\r\nToutes les réponses sont en JSON. En développement, le frontend appelle `/api/...` et le\r\nproxy Vite transmet la requête au backend sans le préfixe `/api`.\r\n\r\nLes requêtes d'exemple se trouvent dans `http/` (extension REST Client de VS Code).\r\n\r\n## Authentification\r\n\r\nLes routes protégées exigent l'en-tête `Authorization` contenant le jeton obtenu à la\r\nconnexion (sans préfixe). Le jeton ne contient que l'identité (`kind`, `id`) ; à chaque\r\nrequête, le backend relit en base le compte, ses rôles et ses entreprises. Un compte\r\ndésactivé, ou un contact sans rôle, ne peut plus accéder à l'API.\r\n\r\n> **Mode démo.** La connexion réelle par lien envoyé par e-mail (CdC EF-01) n'est pas\r\n> implémentée. En développement local, `DEMO_AUTH_ENABLED=true` permet de se connecter\r\n> **sans mot de passe** sous un utilisateur fictif. Ce n'est pas une authentification :\r\n> le serveur refuse de démarrer avec ce mode si `NODE_ENV=production`.\r\n\r\n## Format des erreurs\r\n\r\nToute erreur a la même forme :\r\n\r\n```json\r\n{ \"error\": { \"code\": \"INVALID_QUERY\", \"message\": \"Le paramètre q doit apparaître une seule fois\" } }\r\n```\r\n\r\n| Statut | Code | Cas |\r\n|---|---|---|\r\n| 400 | `INVALID_QUERY` | Paramètre de requête invalide |\r\n| 400 | `INVALID_BODY` | Corps de requête invalide |\r\n| 401 | `UNAUTHENTICATED` | Session absente, expirée ou invalide ; compte non autorisé à se connecter |\r\n| 403 | `FORBIDDEN` | Utilisateur connecté, mais sans droit sur la ressource |\r\n| 404 | `NOT_FOUND` | Route inconnue |\r\n| 500 | `INTERNAL_ERROR` | Erreur inattendue du serveur |\r\n\r\n## GET /health\r\n\r\nIndique que l'API répond.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : `{ \"status\": \"ok\" }`\r\n\r\n## GET /auth/demo-users\r\n\r\n*Mode démo uniquement.* Liste les utilisateurs qui peuvent se connecter : comptes actifs,\r\net contacts ayant au moins un rôle.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'utilisateurs (même format que `GET /auth/me`)\r\n- `404` : mode démo désactivé\r\n\r\n## POST /auth/demo-login\r\n\r\n*Mode démo uniquement.* Ouvre une session sous l'identité choisie, sans mot de passe.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Body JSON : `{ \"kind\": \"ADMIN\" | \"STUDENT\" | \"CONTACT\", \"id\": 4 }`\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : `{ \"token\": \"…\", \"user\": { … } }`\r\n- `400` `INVALID_BODY` : `kind` inconnu ou `id` qui n'est pas un entier positif\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : utilisateur inexistant, inactif, à vérifier, ou contact sans rôle\r\n- `404` : mode démo désactivé\r\n\r\n## GET /auth/me\r\n\r\nRetourne l'utilisateur connecté.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` :\r\n\r\n```json\r\n{\r\n  \"kind\": \"CONTACT\",\r\n  \"id\": 4,\r\n  \"firstName\": \"Julien\",\r\n  \"lastName\": \"Lambert\",\r\n  \"email\": \"julien.lambert@lumen.test\",\r\n  \"roles\": [\"DEPOSITOR\", \"PROMOTER\", \"SIGNATORY\"],\r\n  \"companies\": [\r\n    { \"id\": 3, \"shortName\": \"Lumen Data\" },\r\n    { \"id\": 2, \"shortName\": \"Lumen Digital\" }\r\n  ]\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n`roles` et `companies` sont vides pour un administrateur ou un étudiant.\r\n\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : jeton absent, invalide ou expiré, ou compte désactivé\r\n\r\n## GET /companies\r\n\r\nListe les entreprises, triées par nom complet. Un administrateur voit toutes les\r\nentreprises ; les autres utilisateurs ne voient que les entreprises actives.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Paramètre facultatif `q` : texte cherché dans le nom complet et le nom abrégé, sans tenir\r\n  compte de la casse. Une valeur vide est ignorée. 100 caractères au maximum.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'entreprises\r\n\r\n```json\r\n[\r\n  {\r\n    \"id\": 2,\r\n    \"name\": \"Lumen Digital SRL\",\r\n    \"shortName\": \"Lumen Digital\",\r\n    \"locality\": \"Louvain-la-Neuve\",\r\n    \"status\": \"ACTIVE\"\r\n  }\r\n]\r\n```\r\n\r\n`status` vaut `ACTIVE`, `TO_VERIFY` (fiche à vérifier) ou `ARCHIVED`.\r\n\r\n- `400` `INVALID_QUERY` : `q` est répété ou dépasse 100 caractères.\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide.\r\n\r\n## GET /offers\r\n\r\nListe les offres visibles par l'utilisateur connecté, de l'année académique la plus\r\nrécente à la plus ancienne, puis de la plus récente à la plus ancienne.\r\n\r\n| Profil | Offres retournées |\r\n|---|---|\r\n| Administrateur | Toutes |\r\n| Étudiant | Les offres publiées |\r\n| Contact déposant | Les offres qu'il a déposées, quel que soit leur statut |\r\n| Contact sans rôle de déposant | Aucun accès (403) |\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Paramètre facultatif `period` : `P1`, `P2` ou `Autre`. En son absence, toutes les\r\n  périodes visibles pour le profil sont retournées.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau d'offres\r\n\r\n```json\r\n[\r\n  {\r\n    \"id\": 3,\r\n    \"title\": \"API REST de facturation\",\r\n    \"companyShortName\": \"Orbis\",\r\n    \"academicYear\": \"2026-2027\",\r\n    \"period\": \"P2\",\r\n    \"status\": \"PUBLISHED\"\r\n  }\r\n]\r\n```\r\n\r\n`period` vaut `P1`, `P2` ou `OTHER`. `status` vaut `SUBMITTED` (soumise), `PENDING`\r\n(en attente), `PUBLISHED` (publiée), `ASSIGNED` (attribuée) ou `ARCHIVED` (archivée).\r\n\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide.\r\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : contact seulement promoteur ou signataire.\r\n- `400` `INVALID_QUERY` : paramètre `period` répété ou différent de `P1`, `P2` et `Autre`.\r\n\r\n## POST /applications\r\n\r\nUn étudiant candidate à une offre publiée. L'étudiant est déterminé par la session, jamais\r\npar une valeur du corps de la requête. Le message est facultatif; les espaces extérieurs\r\nsont supprimés, une valeur vide devient `null`, et le texte normalisé ne peut pas dépasser\r\n1000 caractères.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Body JSON : `{ \"offerId\": 5, \"message\": \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\" }`\r\n- `message` peut être omis ou être une chaîne vide.\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `201` : candidature créée\r\n\r\n```json\r\n{\r\n  \"id\": 7,\r\n  \"offerId\": 5,\r\n  \"message\": \"Le sujet m'intéresse.\",\r\n  \"status\": \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n  \"appliedAt\": \"2026-11-09 12:00:00\"\r\n}\r\n```\r\n\r\n- `400` `INVALID_BODY` : corps invalide ou message de plus de 1000 caractères\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide\r\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : utilisateur connecté qui n'est pas étudiant\r\n\n## PATCH /applications/:applicationId/withdraw\n\nRetire la candidature de l'étudiant connecté en passant son statut à `WITHDRAWN`. La ligne\nest conservée dans l'historique. Seule une candidature `IN_PROGRESS` peut être retirée.\nL'appartenance est vérifiée à partir de la session, sans identifiant étudiant fourni par\nle client.\n\n### Requête\n\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\n- `applicationId` : identifiant entier positif de la candidature\n- Aucun corps\n\n### Réponses\n\n- `200` : candidature mise à jour, au format de la réponse `POST /applications`\n- `400` `INVALID_QUERY` : identifiant invalide\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : utilisateur connecté qui n'est pas étudiant\n- `404` `NOT_FOUND` : candidature inexistante ou appartenant à un autre étudiant\n- `409` `APPLICATION_NOT_WITHDRAWABLE` : candidature dont le statut n'est pas `IN_PROGRESS`\n- `404` `NOT_FOUND` : offre inexistante\r\n- `409` `OFFER_NOT_PUBLISHED` : offre existante dont le statut n'est pas `PUBLISHED`\r\n- `409` `APPLICATION_EXISTS` : candidature déjà présente pour cet étudiant et cette offre\r\n  avec un statut différent de `WITHDRAWN`\r\n\r\n## GET /applications/me\r\n\r\nRetourne toutes les candidatures de l'étudiant connecté, y compris celles retirées, de la\r\nplus récente à la plus ancienne. Les données sont filtrées à partir de la session; aucun\r\nidentifiant étudiant n'est accepté dans l'URL ou les paramètres.\r\n\r\n### Requête\r\n\r\n- Header `Authorization` obligatoire\r\n- Aucun paramètre\r\n\r\n### Réponses\r\n\r\n- `200` : tableau de candidatures\r\n\r\n```json\r\n[\r\n  {\r\n    \"id\": 1,\r\n    \"offerId\": 1,\r\n    \"offerTitle\": \"Application React de gestion de flotte\",\r\n    \"companyShortName\": \"Lumen Digital\",\r\n    \"academicYear\": \"2026-2027\",\r\n    \"period\": \"P2\",\r\n    \"message\": \"Le développement React m'intéresse particulièrement.\",\r\n    \"status\": \"IN_PROGRESS\",\r\n    \"appliedAt\": \"2026-10-02 18:10:00\"\r\n  }\r\n]\r\n```\r\n\r\n`status` vaut `IN_PROGRESS`, `SELECTED`, `REJECTED` ou `WITHDRAWN`. `period` vaut `P1`,\r\n`P2` ou `OTHER`. Cette étape retourne les candidatures de toutes les années; le filtre\r\npar défaut sur l'année en cours (EF-72) reste à implémenter.\r\n\r\n- `401` `UNAUTHENTICATED` : session absente ou invalide\r\n- `403` `FORBIDDEN` : utilisateur connecté qui n'est pas étudiant\r\n",

                "text": "import type { Application, ApplicationListItem } from \"../models/application.ts\";\r\nimport { API_URL, readJson } from \"../utils/api.ts\";\r\nimport { isApplication, isApplicationList } from \"../utils/guards.ts\";\r\n\r\nexport const getMyApplications = async (\r\n  token: string,\r\n  signal?: AbortSignal,\r\n): Promise<ApplicationListItem[]> => {\r\n  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/applications/me`, {\r\n    headers: { Authorization: token },\r\n    signal,\r\n  });\r\n  return readJson(response, isApplicationList, \"Chargement de vos candidatures impossible\");\r\n};\r\n\nexport const withdrawMyApplication = async (\n  token: string,\n  applicationId: number,\n): Promise<Application> => {\n  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/applications/${applicationId}/withdraw`, {\n    method: \"PATCH\",\n    headers: { Authorization: token },\n  });\n  return readJson(response, isApplication, \"Retrait de la candidature impossible\");\n};\n\r\nexport const createApplication = async (\r\n  token: string,\r\n  offerId: number,\r\n  message: string,\r\n): Promise<Application> => {\r\n  const response = await fetch(`${API_URL}/applications`, {\r\n    method: \"POST\",\r\n    headers: {\r\n      Authorization: token,\r\n      \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",\r\n    },\r\n    body: JSON.stringify({ offerId, message }),\r\n  });\r\n  return readJson(response, isApplication, \"Envoi de la candidature impossible\");\r\n};",

            [
              {
                "text": "import { useEffect, useState } from \"react\";\r\nimport type { ApplicationListItem } from \"../models/application.ts\";\r\nimport { getMyApplications, withdrawMyApplication } from \"../services/applications.service.ts\";\nimport { isUnauthorized } from \"../utils/api.ts\";\r\n\r\nexport const useApplications = (token: string, onUnauthorized: () => void) => {\r\n  const [applications, setApplications] = useState<ApplicationListItem[]>([]);\r\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);\r\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\r\n  const [withdrawalError, setWithdrawalError] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const [withdrawingId, setWithdrawingId] = useState<number | null>(null);\n\n  const withdrawApplication = async (applicationId: number) => {\n    setWithdrawingId(applicationId);\n    setWithdrawalError(null);\n    try {\n      const withdrawn = await withdrawMyApplication(token, applicationId);\n      setApplications((current) =>\n        current.map((application) =>\n          application.id === withdrawn.id ? { ...application, status: withdrawn.status } : application,\n        ),\n      );\n    } catch (reason) {\n      if (isUnauthorized(reason)) {\n        onUnauthorized();\n      } else {\n        setWithdrawalError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : \"Erreur inconnue\");\n      }\n    } finally {\n      setWithdrawingId(null);\n    }\n  };\n\r\n  useEffect(() => {\r\n    const controller = new AbortController();\r\n    setIsLoading(true);\r\n    setError(null);\r\n\r\n    getMyApplications(token, controller.signal)\r\n      .then((data) => {\r\n        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setApplications(data);\r\n      })\r\n      .catch((reason: unknown) => {\r\n        if (controller.signal.aborted) return;\r\n        if (isUnauthorized(reason)) {\r\n          onUnauthorized();\r\n        } else {\r\n          setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : \"Erreur inconnue\");\r\n        }\r\n      })\r\n      .finally(() => {\r\n        if (!controller.signal.aborted) setIsLoading(false);\r\n      });\r\n\r\n    return () => controller.abort();\r\n  }, [token, onUnauthorized]);\r\n\r\n  return {\n    applications,\n    isLoading,\n    error,\n    withdrawalError,\n    withdrawingId,\n    withdrawApplication,\n  };\n};",

                "text": "import EmptyState from \"../components/EmptyState.tsx\";\r\nimport ErrorState from \"../components/ErrorState.tsx\";\r\nimport LoadingState from \"../components/LoadingState.tsx\";\r\nimport StatusBadge from \"../components/StatusBadge.tsx\";\r\nimport { useApplications } from \"../hooks/useApplications.ts\";\r\nimport { APPLICATION_STATUS_LABELS, APPLICATION_STATUS_TONES, PERIOD_LABELS } from \"../utils/labels.ts\";\r\n\r\ninterface ApplicationsPageProps {\r\n  token: string;\r\n  onUnauthorized: () => void;\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst ApplicationsPage = ({ token, onUnauthorized }: ApplicationsPageProps) => {\r\n  const {\n    applications,\n    isLoading,\n    error,\n    withdrawalError,\n    withdrawingId,\n    withdrawApplication,\n  } = useApplications(token, onUnauthorized);\n\r\n  if (error) return <ErrorState message={error} />;\r\n  if (isLoading) return <LoadingState />;\r\n  if (applications.length === 0) {\r\n    return (\r\n      <section>\r\n        <h1>Mes candidatures</h1>\r\n        <EmptyState message=\"Vous n'avez pas encore candidaté à une offre.\" />\r\n      </section>\r\n    );\r\n  }\r\n\r\n  return (\r\n    <section>\r\n      <h1>Mes candidatures</h1>\r\n      <p className=\"result-count\">\r\n        {applications.length} candidature{applications.length > 1 ? \"s\" : \"\"}\r\n      </p>\r\n      {withdrawalError && <ErrorState message={withdrawalError} />}\n      <div className=\"table-wrapper\">\r\n        <table className=\"data-table\">\r\n          <thead>\r\n            <tr>\r\n              <th scope=\"col\">Offre</th>\r\n              <th scope=\"col\">Entreprise</th>\r\n              <th scope=\"col\">Année</th>\r\n              <th scope=\"col\">Période</th>\r\n              <th scope=\"col\">Date</th>\r\n              <th scope=\"col\">Message</th>\r\n              <th scope=\"col\">Statut</th>\r\n              <th scope=\"col\">Action</th>\n            </tr>\r\n          </thead>\r\n          <tbody>\r\n            {applications.map((application) => (\r\n              <tr key={application.id}>\r\n                <td>{application.offerTitle}</td>\r\n                <td>{application.companyShortName}</td>\r\n                <td>{application.academicYear}</td>\r\n                <td>{PERIOD_LABELS[application.period]}</td>\r\n                <td>\r\n                  <time dateTime={application.appliedAt}>{application.appliedAt.slice(0, 10)}</time>\r\n                </td>\r\n                <td>{application.message ?? \"Aucun message\"}</td>\r\n                <td>\r\n                  <StatusBadge\r\n                    label={APPLICATION_STATUS_LABELS[application.status]}\r\n                    tone={APPLICATION_STATUS_TONES[application.status]}\r\n                  />\r\n                </td>\r\n                <td>\n                  {application.status === \"IN_PROGRESS\" && (\n                    <button\n                      className=\"button\"\n                      type=\"button\"\n                      disabled={withdrawingId !== null}\n                      onClick={() => void withdrawApplication(application.id)}\n                    >\n                      {withdrawingId === application.id ? \"Retrait…\" : \"Retirer\"}\n                    </button>\n                  )}\n                </td>\n              </tr>\r\n            ))}\r\n          </tbody>\r\n        </table>\r\n      </div>\r\n    </section>\r\n  );\r\n};\r\n\r\nexport default ApplicationsPage;",

                "text": "import { Router } from \"express\";\r\nimport { toApplicationDto, toApplicationListItemDto } from \"../mappers/application.mapper.ts\";\r\nimport { getCurrentUser } from \"../middlewares/authenticate.ts\";\r\nimport { authorize } from \"../middlewares/authorize.ts\";\r\nimport type { ApplicationsService } from \"../services/applications.service.ts\";\r\nimport {\r\n  canApplyToOffers,\r\n  canViewOwnApplications,\r\n  canWithdrawOwnApplications,\r\n} from \"../services/permissions.ts\";\r\nimport { HttpError } from \"../utils/httpError.ts\";\r\n\r\ninterface CreateApplicationBody {\r\n  offerId: number;\r\n  message?: string;\r\n}\r\n\r\nconst isCreateApplicationBody = (value: unknown): value is CreateApplicationBody => {\r\n  if (typeof value !== \"object\" || value === null || Array.isArray(value)) return false;\r\n  const body = value as Record<string, unknown>;\r\n  return (\r\n    typeof body.offerId === \"number\" &&\r\n    Number.isInteger(body.offerId) &&\r\n    body.offerId > 0 &&\r\n    (body.message === undefined || typeof body.message === \"string\")\r\n  );\r\n};\r\n\r\nconst parseApplicationId = (value: unknown): number => {\n  if (typeof value !== \"string\" || !/^[1-9]\\d*$/.test(value)) {\n    throw new HttpError(400, \"INVALID_QUERY\", \"L'identifiant de candidature doit être un entier positif\");\r\n  }\r\n  const applicationId = Number(value);\r\n  if (!Number.isSafeInteger(applicationId)) {\r\n    throw new HttpError(400, \"INVALID_QUERY\", \"L'identifiant de candidature doit être un entier positif\");\r\n  }\r\n  return applicationId;\r\n};\r\n\r\nexport const createApplicationsRouter = (applicationsService: ApplicationsService) => {\r\n  const router = Router();\r\n\r\n  router.get(\"/me\", authorize(canViewOwnApplications), (req, res) => {\r\n    const applications = applicationsService.listOwnApplications(getCurrentUser(req));\r\n    res.json(applications.map(toApplicationListItemDto));\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  router.patch(\"/:applicationId/withdraw\", authorize(canWithdrawOwnApplications), (req, res) => {\r\n    const application = applicationsService.withdrawApplication(\r\n      getCurrentUser(req),\r\n      parseApplicationId(req.params.applicationId),\r\n    );\r\n    res.json(toApplicationDto(application));\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  router.post(\"/\", authorize(canApplyToOffers), (req, res) => {\r\n    const body: unknown = req.body;\r\n    if (!isCreateApplicationBody(body)) {\r\n      throw new HttpError(\r\n        400,\r\n        \"INVALID_BODY\",\r\n        \"Le corps doit contenir offerId (entier positif) et un message facultatif\",\r\n      );\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    const application = applicationsService.applyToOffer(\r\n      getCurrentUser(req),\r\n      body.offerId,\r\n      body.message,\r\n    );\r\n    res.status(201).json(toApplicationDto(application));\r\n  });\r\n\r\n  return router;\r\n};",
